title: VRM Metaverse Interaction Prototype
description:
I want to turn my physical VRM machine into a digital twin that people can walk around and play with inside a brand-new Metaverse space we create from scratch. In this first release the visitor simply steps into a single virtual room, explores the machine, presses its buttons and immediately sees lights, sounds or animations react—no complex multiplayer or guided training yet, just pure “touch and watch it respond” fun.

Core focus 
• The scene must run smoothly on a Temu-ready headset (Quest 2 for my own testing is fine) and desktop VR. 
• Natural room-scale movement, teleport or smooth locomotion, plus basic hand tracking for the button presses. 
• Clean, modular architecture so we can later port the exact same experience into Second Life and a standalone app without rewriting everything.

I will provide reference CAD models, texture packs and logic diagrams for each button response. You take care of engine setup (Unity, Unreal or comparable WebXR stack), import, rigging, animation, VFX/audio cues and headset integration.

Acceptance criteria 
1. One-room environment loads with the VRM machine centred. 
2. All labelled buttons detect presses via hand or controller and trigger the specified visual/audio response. 
3. Build package installs and runs on Quest 2 / Temu headset; source project delivered with clear, commented code.

Deliver these and we move to the multi-world phase next.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен MVP VR-прототипа: виртуальная комната с цифровым двойником VRM-машины, где пользователь нажимает кнопки руками или контроллерами, а машина реагирует светом, звуком и анимацией. Сборка должна работать на Quest 2 и десктопном VR, архитектура должна позволять перенос в Second Life и standalone-приложение. Бюджет 1500 USD явно не соответствует объёму работ по 3D, риггингу и VR.
analysis.reply:
You want one virtual room where visitors walk up to your VRM machine, press its labelled buttons by hand or controller, and see lights, sounds and animations react, with the core structured so it can later move to Second Life and a standalone app. I would build it as a WebXR scene with three.js or Babylon.js, so it runs in the Quest 2 browser and on desktop VR. The plan: teleport and smooth locomotion, press detection on each button, and a data-driven mapping from each button to its light, sound or animation cue, kept separate from the scene logic to make the later ports easier. With AI-assisted development I can move quickly through this first milestone, roughly 3 to 4 weeks for the room, interactions and a Quest build. Would a WebXR build work for you instead of a native Unity app? And are the CAD models already optimized for real-time use?

Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужна одна виртуальная комната, где посетители подходят к вашей VRM-машине, нажимают подписанные кнопки руками или контроллерами и видят реакцию света, звука и анимации. Архитектуру стоит сделать так, чтобы потом можно было перенести её в Second Life и standalone-приложение. Я бы собрал сцену на WebXR с three.js или Babylon.js, чтобы она работала в браузере Quest 2 и на десктопном VR. План: телепорт и плавное перемещение, детекция нажатий на каждую кнопку и привязка каждой кнопки к свету, звуку или анимации через конфигурацию, отдельную от логики сцены, что упростит последующие переносы. С помощью ИИ-ассистентов я могу быстро пройти первый этап, примерно за 3–4 недели: комната, взаимодействия и сборка под Quest. Подойдёт ли вам WebXR-сборка вместо нативного приложения на Unity? И оптимизированы ли CAD-модели для работы в реальном времени?

title: Build Snowflake AI Query Automation Agent -- 2
description:

I want to have a custom claude like custom gpt to execute the queries that I give using snowfalke. and it need to generate 3 sets of queries for each custom schema based on the tables list generated in the initially executed query. I will provide the details how the queries should be.

I want to have eks cluster to execute all this meaning connect to snowflake and run inital queries . Process the 3 sets of queries that were dynamically generated by custom claude and send it the snowflake and the output should be 3 excel sheets sent to the ms outlook ans as well as these should be sent to a location in the aws s3 bucket under a date folder.

Also the results can be displayed in the browser in the front end.

For this I need to build an agent
technical stack: 
python
claude
snowflake 
aws eks

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен Python-агент: он получает список таблиц из Snowflake, через Claude генерирует по 3 набора запросов для каждой из трёх схем, выполняет их и выгружает результаты в три Excel-файла. Файлы должны уходить в Outlook и в S3 по папкам с датой, а также отображаться в браузере. Развёртывание на AWS EKS. Бюджет очень низкий для такого объёма работ.
analysis.reply:
You need a pipeline that reads table metadata from Snowflake, has Claude generate three query sets per schema, runs them, and delivers three Excel files to Outlook, to S3 in date-based folders, and to a browser view. I'd build it in phases: first the core Snowflake → Claude → Excel → S3 flow as a containerized Python service, then Outlook delivery, then the front end. The EKS part can start as a Deployment plus a CronJob. At $15 I can realistically cover only the first phase, so I'd suggest we agree on that scope and price the rest separately. Phase one would take about 5–7 days. Could you share the column specs and the query logic you have in mind, and do you already have an Azure AD app for sending mail through Microsoft Graph? Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: WordPress AI Assistant Integration
description:
I need an AI-powered chat assistant added to my WordPress site so visitors can ask questions and get instant, accurate answers. The assistant must draw information from two sources: everything already published on the site (pages and blog posts) and a concise FAQ document that I will supply. Whenever the bot genuinely does not have an answer, it should clearly say so and point the visitor toward the most relevant pages instead of pushing them to email or a form. 

Please handle the full setup: selecting or configuring the most suitable WordPress-compatible AI plugin (OpenAI, GPT-based, or similar), connecting it to the content sources mentioned, styling the widget so it matches my existing theme, and testing to be sure responses remain on-brand and helpful. I also have a handful of outdated images that need swapping for new ones while you are already working in the media library. 

Deliverables 
• Installed and configured AI chat plugin trained on live site content and my FAQ PDF/Doc 
• Front-end widget styled to fit current theme colors and typography 
• Logic verified: if the bot cannot answer, it states that and recommends related pages 
• Outdated images replaced with the new files I provide 
• Brief hand-off notes showing me where to update training data in future 

The job is straightforward but I want it done carefully; clean, well-commented settings or snippets are a must so I can maintain the system myself after launch.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужно добавить на сайт WordPress чат-виджет на базе ИИ, который отвечает по опубликованным страницам, записям и FAQ-документу клиента. Если ответа нет, бот должен сообщить об этом и предложить похожие страницы. Также нужно стилизовать виджет под тему и заменить устаревшие изображения в медиатеке.
analysis.reply:
You need an AI chat widget on your WordPress site that answers from published pages, posts and your FAQ, and that admits when it doesn't know and points visitors to the right pages instead of a contact form. I'd build it as a small custom plugin on the OpenAI API rather than a heavy third-party one: a retrieval layer that indexes posts, pages and the FAQ, a system prompt tuned to your tone, a fallback that links related pages when confidence is low, and a widget styled from your theme's CSS variables. All settings and snippets will be commented, with a short hand-off note on where to update the FAQ. Estimated timeline: about 5–7 working days, including testing and the image swap. Two questions: which WordPress version and hosting do you use, and do you already have an OpenAI API key?

See live demos in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

Вам нужен чат-виджет на базе ИИ для сайта WordPress, который отвечает по опубликованным страницам, записям и вашему FAQ, честно сообщает, когда ответа нет, и направляет посетителей на нужные страницы вместо контактной формы. title: DevOps Mentor / Freelancer: Hands-on Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, Jenkins, Prometheus & Grafana
description:
**Project Description**

We are looking for an experienced DevOps engineer to mentor a candidate through real-world deployment. The candidate is a technical project manager, so the goal is a solid working understanding of these technologies, not deep expertise in everything. The candidate wants to learn by building, not by watching tutorials. You will guide the candidate step by step, review their work, and help them deploy a sample application end to end.

**Learning Goal**

The candidate does not need to know every technology in depth. The candidate needs to understand how each tool works, why it is used, how the pieces fit together, and be able to discuss them confidently with engineering teams and in interviews. Please focus on practical understanding and the big picture over advanced configuration.

**What We Will Build**

Deploy a sample web application on AWS using Docker and Kubernetes, with a CI/CD pipeline and full monitoring, using the workflows a production team would use.

**Scope of Work**
- Git / GitHub workflow: branching strategy, pull requests, code review
- Containerize an application with Docker
- Set up AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, Lambda)
- Deploy and manage the app on Kubernetes (K8s)
- Build CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitHub Actions
- Write infrastructure as code with Terraform (basics)
- Set up monitoring and alerting with Prometheus, Alertmanager and Grafana
- Practice deployment strategies: blue/green, canary and rollback
- Set up separate dev, staging and production environments

**Requirements**
- 4+ years of hands-on DevOps / Cloud / SRE experience
- Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS and Jenkins
- Experience with Prometheus and Grafana in production
- Able to explain concepts clearly and patiently to a non-developer with a project management background
- Fluent English
- Prior mentoring or teaching experience is a plus
- AWS or Kubernetes certification (AWS SAA, CKA) is a plus

**Deliverables**
- Daily live 1-on-1 sessions with screen share
- A working project in the candidate's own GitHub repository
- Weekly tasks with feedback and code review
- Short documentation or architecture diagram of the final project
- Interview preparation: explaining the project and answering common DevOps and SDLC questions from a technical project manager's point of view

**Schedule**
- Duration: 6 to 8 weeks

**To Apply, Please Include**
1. A short summary of your DevOps experience
2. A similar project or mentoring work you have done

Это обучение, а не разработка продукта, и требуется опыт DevOps 4+ лет, которого нет в профиле Якова.

title: Estate Longevity Projection Models
description:
Each of my annuity clients needs a clear, easy-to-read projection that shows how long their money may last across their full life expectancy. For every case I will provide age, current account balances, anticipated investment returns, annual income streams (Social Security, pensions, annuity income), living expenses, expected withdrawals, and an inflation assumption. Using those fixed inputs, build one deterministic forecast that tracks estate value year-by-year, highlights any depletion point, and summarises net worth at key milestones such as age 75, 85, and 95.

Alongside the cash-flow projection, please recommend a target portfolio allocation that blends low-cost index funds or ETFs with fixed indexed annuities. Explain the rationale behind the mix so I can discuss it confidently with clients.

I handle roughly 100 similar cases per year, so I’m looking for a repeatable workflow: ideally a templated Excel or Google Sheets model plus a client-friendly PDF report generated from the sheet. Charts that visually trace the estate balance over time are essential.

To ensure the pilot is spot-on, I’ll start by sending one representative client file. Accuracy of calculations, clarity of presentation, and turnaround time will guide whether we proceed to the wider engagement.

Бюджет низкий, а рекомендации по портфелю и аннуитетам требуют лицензированной экспертизы, которой у меня нет.
analysis.reply: You need a repeatable model: fixed inputs per client, a year-by-year deterministic projection of the estate, a depletion flag, net worth at ages 75, 85 and 95, and a PDF report built from the sheet. I'd build this as a Google Sheets template with an input tab, formula-driven projection, and charts, then add a script that fills the report and exports it to PDF for each case, so one client file becomes a finished report without manual copying. I can start with your representative file and deliver the pilot template within a few days, then tune it against your numbers. The portfolio allocation rationale would need your own professional judgment as the advisor, so I'd handle the model and report automation only. Two questions: do you have a preferred report layout or branding, and should returns and inflation be single fixed rates or per-year schedules? Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/ Yakov

title: Product Competitor Research Spreadsheet

title: Sales-Focused Google Ads Management -- 2

Both our B2B and B2C audiences need to be served, so messaging, keyword groups and landing-page routing must reflect the different decision journeys. Campaigns will run only on Google Search and the Google Display Network; YouTube is outside the current scope.

Work begins with a short discovery call to confirm profit-driving products, margins, and any existing historical data. From there I expect:

• Complete account and conversion-tracking audit, fixing or installing tags in Google Ads and Google Analytics 4 so revenue attribution is exact. 
• Fresh campaign structure (Search and Display), including negative-keyword hygiene, audience layering and responsive creative. 
• Compelling ad copy written around clear value propositions, tested via at least two variants per ad group. 
• Ongoing bid, budget and placement optimisation for a minimum of four weeks, with weekly performance summaries showing cost, ROAS, CPA and next-step actions.

Success is defined by demonstrable sales growth that exceeds our current baseline while hitting agreed CPA/ROAS targets. Access to the Google Ads account, Analytics, product feed (if needed) and creative assets will be provided immediately after kickoff; everything else—strategy documents, live dashboards, and campaign files—should remain fully shareable so we can continue scaling once the initial engagement ends.

title: Desktop Thermometer App Field Trial(only from Uk
description:
Join CoolRater’s winter 2026–27 field trial of a Windows app that measures the Heat-Transfer Coefficient of your home, a statistic used to support heat-pump sizing. Participants will install the app, connect an Octopus Energy account, provide half-hourly smart-meter data, and collect overnight temperatures using four Elitech RC-5+ loggers, which will be provided. Applicants must heat their home with a gas boiler and avoid using energy outside the home during trial sessions. Basic computer skills are sufficient; CSV editing and installing unsigned trial software are required. Five participants are sought each month from November 2026 to February 2027. 

CoolRater is a desktop app which will measure the heat transfer coefficient HTC for a building, a function that has become increasingly important in recent years for use in sizing heat pumps. A field trial is being run this winter with these objectives: 

1. To obtain temperature and energy data for a range of properties. Currently CoolRater has only been used for the author’s own property. 

2. to obtain data from properties where the temperature varies between locations due to variations in insulation or heat distribution. For example close to a solid floor with no insulation, or in rooms which do not have double glazing. 

3. To find out if users have any problems in using the app, or have any dislikes or need for additional features or improvements. 

There are some specific requirements for participants: 

1. The app only supports Windows (10 or 11); 
2. heating must be with a gas boiler; 
3. your energy supplier must be Octopus Energy, and you must be able to connect to the Octopus API, which means that you will have to live in the UK. 
4. you must have a smart meter, configured to record energy use every 30 minutes. As a quick check that the smart meter and API is working correctly, there is a feature on the Octopus website where you can download smart meter data. Log in to your Octopus account, click your name top right, click My Energy, scroll down to "Get your energy geek on" you can download files of energy usage. Please download two days of energy data and attach it to your proposal, so that I can see that you have a working smart meter. 
5. during the trial, which is only active at night, you will not be able to use energy for anything outside the house, like charging EVs. 

To collect the temperature data you will be provided with four Elitech RC-5+ logging thermometers. To send you these, I will need your address. Exchanging contact details is discouraged by PPH rules, but is allowed after a proposal has been accepted if it is necessary to mail equipment. Note that a similar project is also posted which differs only in that participants buy their own thermometers, receive a higher amount as a result, and do not therefore need to provide their address. 

A high level of computer expertise is not required but you will need to copy your API key from your Octopus account to the app, you may need to edit CSV files with Excel or LibraOffice, and install the app. As trial software it has not been possible to digitally sign it and it has had few downloads. Therefore the operating system will treat it with suspicion and advise you not to run it. You can run it against this advice by clicking “More Information” and “Run Anyway”. 

The video https://youtu.be/HryknL9LGqQ gives instructions on using the app and shows what you will need to do as a participant in the field trial. 

Criteria for Job Completion 

As trial software its difficult to be certain of how well it will work. The app calculates the HTC for each inside thermometer by three different methods. If for any one of the thermometers the results agree to within 10%, then jobs a good’un. If they don’t, then this often indicates a problem with the thermometer being close to a heating source. So I would like you to repeat the test one or two times to get a better result. Return either one project file with the results agreeing to within 10%, or three project files from three separate attempts. 

It is intended that there will be five participants in each of the months November 2026 to February 2027.

title: Custom Service Booking Platform Build
description:
I need a brand-new, database-driven web application that lets visitors create their own accounts, browse the services I offer, and place bookings or service requests from any device.

Scope
• User accounts with secure registration, login, password reset, and profile management 
• Service catalogue where each item can be viewed, filtered, and added to a booking cart or request form 
• End-to-end booking flow: select date/time, confirm details, and receive automated e-mail notifications 
• Admin dashboard to view, edit, and fulfill incoming orders, plus manage users and service listings 
• Mobile-first, responsive UI so the experience is smooth on phones, tablets, and desktops 
• Clean, well-commented code and a normalized database structure for easy future expansion

Tech & collaboration
I’m flexible on the stack as long as it delivers fast page loads, secure data handling, and straightforward deployment. If you favour C#, PHP, ASP.NET MVC, or a comparable framework, let me know your recommended approach. Version control in Git and clear commit messages are a must so I can track progress.

What I’ll provide
• Brand assets, basic wireframes, and a detailed list of services 
• Prompt feedback on milestones and any technical questions

Deliverables
1. Working web application deployed to my hosting or a staging server 
2. Source code repository with installation instructions 
3. Brief hand-off document outlining database schema and key configuration steps

If you have built booking, ordering, or scheduling systems before, please share a link or brief demo in your proposal.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик ищет адаптивное веб-приложение для онлайн-записи на услуги: регистрация пользователей, каталог услуг с фильтрами, выбор даты и времени, email-уведомления и админ-панель для управления заказами, пользователями и услугами. Бюджет 750 USD.

You need a responsive booking platform where visitors register, browse your services, and book a date and time, with an admin panel to manage orders, users and listings. I'd build it on a modern stack (Node.js with TypeScript and PostgreSQL, or Laravel if you prefer PHP on your hosting), using a normalized schema for users, services and bookings, secure token-based auth with password reset, and transactional e-mails for confirmations. A first working version with the core booking flow and admin dashboard would take about 2–3 weeks, followed by mobile polish, deployment to your staging server, and a hand-off document with the repository and setup steps. Two questions: do you have a hosting preference that rules out a particular stack, and should time slots be blocked per staff member or only per service?

Live demos are in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужна адаптивная платформа для онлайн-записи, где посетители регистрируются, просматривают ваши услуги и выбирают дату и время, а в админ-панели вы управляете заказами, пользователями и услугами. title: Simple Web App Development
description:
I’m looking for someone who can build a clean, reliable website or lightweight web application from the ground up. At this stage the idea is still flexible, so I’m open to your suggestions on the best stack—whether that’s React, Vue, Angular, or a more minimalist vanilla-JS approach—as long as the final result is responsive, well-structured, and easy to maintain.

What I need from you: 
• A straightforward, modern interface that looks good on both desktop and mobile. 
• Well-commented source code delivered through a Git repository. 
• Clear deployment instructions so I can launch the app on my own hosting once the work is complete.

When you bid, briefly outline the stack you’d like to use, the main milestones you foresee, and how long you expect each to take. If you have links to similar projects, feel free to share them—seeing real examples helps me make a quick decision.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент ищет разработчика, который создаст с нуля простое, адаптивное веб-приложение или сайт. Стек он оставляет на выбор исполнителя (React, Vue, Angular или vanilla JS). Нужны понятная структура, комментарии в коде, Git-репозиторий и инструкция по развёртыванию на собственном хостинге. Бюджет 750 USD, сроки и детали пока открыты.
analysis.reply:
You're looking for a clean, responsive web app built from scratch, with the stack left open, well-commented code in Git, and deployment steps you can follow on your own hosting. Since the scope is still flexible, I'd start with a short discovery step to lock down the core features and choose the stack. For an app like this I'd lean toward React with a small component set, or plain JS if the interactions stay simple, because both are easy to maintain. Rough milestones: scope and wireframes (1–2 days), core UI and responsive layout (about a week), main functionality and data handling (1–2 weeks), then testing, documentation and the deployment guide (2–3 days). Overall, roughly 3–4 weeks depending on the feature set.

Which features are must-haves for the first version, and will the app need a backend or existing data?

You can see live demos in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужно чистое адаптивное веб-приложение с нуля, со свободным выбором стека, хорошо прокомментированным кодом в Git и инструкцией по развёртыванию на вашем хостинге. Поскольку объём пока гибкий, я бы начал с короткого этапа обсуждения, чтобы зафиксировать ключевые функции и выбрать стек. Для такого приложения я бы склонился к React с небольшим набором компонентов или к чистому JS, если взаимодействия простые, так как оба варианта легко поддерживать. Примерные этапы: объём и макеты (1–2 дня), основной интерфейс и адаптивная вёрстка (около недели), основная функциональность и работа с данными (1–2 недели), затем тестирование, документация и инструкция по развёртыванию (2–3 дня). В итоге примерно 3–4 недели в зависимости от набора функций.

Какие функции обязательны в первой версии и понадобится ли бэкенд или существующие данные?

Fantasy cricket platform that allows users to build virtual teams, enter contests for upcoming matches, track live scores and leaderboards, and view finalized results. The platform is being developed as an independent product with original branding, UI/UX, and backend architecture, taking functional inspiration from market-leading fantasy sports models.

This engagement covers end-to-end development delivered by a freelance/contract team, including:

Mobile App (Android & iOS): User registration, match discovery, 11-player fantasy team creation with credit and role constraints, contest entry and tracking, live points updates, leaderboards, results, notifications, and conditional wallet/payment flows.

Backend Services: Authentication, match/player data integration, team validation, configurable scoring engine, contest integrity controls, live event processing, leaderboard computation, audit logging, and API infrastructure.

Admin Dashboard (Web): Match and contest management, scoring rule configuration, user and eligibility oversight, manual result review and finalization, transaction/reconciliation monitoring (if paid contests are enabled), reporting, and operational alerts.

Key Constraints & Assumptions:

Cricket match and player data will be sourced via an agreed third-party provider.

All paid/real-money features (deposits, entry fees, withdrawals, KYC, tax handling) are scoped as conditional modules and will only be implemented upon confirmed legal clearance and provider agreements.

Final scoring rules, contest formats, and tie/abandonment policies will be configured through the admin panel based on the client’s approved rulebook.

Deliverables: Native mobile builds, backend APIs and database, admin web panel, integration documentation, automated tests, deployment configurations, and operational handover materials.

For the app, I'd suggest a cross-platform framework to keep Android and iOS on one codebase, unless you need native builds. title: Business Booking Mobile App in FlutterFlow and Flutter with Supabase

title: End-to-End Automated Trading Bot
description:

Order execution speed and reliability are priorities; the system must manage entry, scaling, and exit logic exactly as the strategy dictates.

Python is my first choice because of its mature trading libraries (ccxt, pandas, TA-Lib, etc.), but I will consider another language if it offers clear advantages. The code should be clean, modular, and easy for me to tweak later.

Alongside the core automation I’d like to explore sensible add-ons such as basic risk controls, a lightweight performance dashboard, or push notifications, provided they don’t bloat the build. I’m open to your suggestions on architecture, deployment (local vs. cloud/VPS), and logging.

Deliverables
• A working bot that places trades automatically through my broker/exchange API 
• Well-commented source code and any configuration files 
• A concise setup & usage guide that lets me launch, monitor, and update the bot on my own

To keep the project moving efficiently, please outline the tech stack you plan to use, the milestones you foresee, and the estimated turnaround time.

title: Veterinary AI Automation SaaS Development
description:
AI Developer Needed – Turn Existing Veterinary AI Automation Bot into a Standalone SaaS Platform

Project Overview

I'm looking for an experienced AI developer / full-stack SaaS developer to help turn an existing AI automation system into a standalone, commercially distributable software platform.

I've already developed and tested the core automation using Grok-based AI bots within a real veterinary clinic environment. The system currently operates across three veterinary clinics and automates several operational and administrative monitoring processes.

The objective is to take the existing working solution and develop it into a standalone web-based application that can eventually be distributed and sold to veterinary clinics, initially in Australia and potentially internationally.

This is not a project to build an AI concept from scratch. The core automation and workflows already exist. I need someone who can understand the existing system, improve its architecture and develop a proper standalone product around it.

What the software currently does

The AI automation system acts as an operational assistant for veterinary practices.

Its existing functionality includes:

Logging into veterinary practice management software (currently ezyVet).

Reviewing clinical records and consultation notes.

Monitoring rechecks, diagnostics, injections, admissions and dental procedures.

Reviewing CCC and veterinary call notes.

Identifying patients awaiting callbacks where no subsequent update has been documented.

Flagging outstanding tasks and potential workflow oversights.

Reviewing daily clinic activity.

Generating structured management summaries highlighting matters requiring attention.

The system currently operates on a scheduled basis and prepares reports for practice management.

What I need developed

I want to turn this into a standalone SaaS platform with the following functionality:

1. Standalone web application

A professional web-based dashboard.

Secure user authentication and login system.

Individual accounts for veterinary clinics.

Ability to support multiple clinics under one organisation.

A centralised dashboard showing the AI automation results.

2. Multi-tenant architecture

Each veterinary clinic must have its own isolated account and data.

Ability for administrators to create, manage and deactivate clinic accounts.

Individual clinic configurations and settings.

Ability to manage multiple locations under one veterinary group.

3. AI automation integration

Migrate or rebuild the existing Grok-based automation into a standalone architecture.

Preserve the existing prompts, logic and workflows where appropriate.

Connect the AI agents to the relevant veterinary practice management systems.

Allow scheduled automated reviews.

Generate reports identifying outstanding tasks, callbacks and potential workflow gaps.

4. ezyVet integration

Explore integration through the ezyVet API rather than relying solely on browser-based automation.

Secure authentication and authorised access to clinic data.

Retrieve relevant patient, consultation, clinical and communication records.

Process the information through the AI automation system.

Display the results within the standalone dashboard.

5. Reporting and notifications

Daily automated management reports.

Clear categorisation of flagged issues.

Ability to review historical reports.

Notifications when important issues are identified.

Ability for clinic managers to acknowledge and track flagged items.

6. Future commercial functionality

The platform needs to be built with future commercial distribution in mind.

This includes:

Subscription management.

Different pricing tiers.

Clinic onboarding.

Admin dashboard for managing customers.

Ability to add or remove clinic users.

Usage monitoring and AI API cost tracking.

Scalable cloud infrastructure.

Important Technical Requirements

I'm looking for someone experienced with:

Full-stack SaaS development.

AI agent development and orchestration.

Grok / xAI API integration.

OpenAI API integration (where appropriate).

Python, Node.js or similar backend technologies.

React / Next.js or similar frontend frameworks.

API integrations and third-party authentication.

Multi-tenant SaaS architecture.

Database design and secure cloud deployment.

Veterinary practice management software integrations (ezyVet experience is a bonus).

What I expect from the developer

I want someone who can first review the existing Grok bot and understand how the current automation works.

The first stage will involve:

Reviewing the existing bot and automation workflows.

Assessing the current architecture and identifying what can be reused.

Recommending the best approach for converting it into a standalone application.

Providing a development roadmap, timeline and cost estimate.

Following this, we can move into the actual development stages.

Important – Ownership and Confidentiality

This is an existing product that I intend to commercialise.

All newly developed source code, application architecture, configurations and deliverables created specifically for this project must be assigned to me under a written agreement.

A confidentiality and IP assignment agreement will be required before access to the existing automation, prompts or proprietary workflows is provided.

I am looking for a developer who can potentially become a long-term technical partner as the platform grows.

To Apply

Please provide:

Examples of SaaS platforms you have developed.

Your experience building AI agents and automation systems.

Your experience with multi-tenant applications and user authentication.

Whether you've worked with ezyVet or similar practice management APIs.

How you would approach converting an existing AI bot into a standalone SaaS product.

Your estimated development timeline and budget.

Please don't apply if your approach is to build an entirely new system without first assessing the existing working solution.

I'm looking for someone who understands both AI automation and commercial SaaS development.

title: Mobile Catering Operations Management App
description:
Build a Mobile-Friendly Catering Operations App

We run a central kitchen supplying meals to groups at multiple hotels in Saudi Arabia. We need one system connecting orders, stores, procurement, cooking, packing, delivery and management.

Required features:

1. Role-based access: Owner, operations, inventory, cook, packer, delivery and accounts, with delegated approvals and restricted financial access.

2. Order planning: Customer/group, hotel, dates, meals, pax, menu package, special meals, packing preferences and delivery instructions. Support recurring orders and consolidated production with separate hotel allocations.

3. Recipes and batches: Versioned recipes, ingredient units, portions, cooked yield and tested vessel capacities. Support ingredient-specific scaling rules and subrecipes rather than blindly multiplying every ingredient by pax. Provide Excel import templates.

4. Inventory: Purchases, receipts, shortages, partial/extra issues, cook receipt confirmation, unused returns, wastage and stock adjustments.

5. Cook interface: Simple mobile/shared-tablet screens with English/Tamil labels, upcoming plans, ingredient quantities, cooking status, actual output and exception reporting.

6. Packing and delivery: Individual boxes or bulk containers, special-meal separation, planned versus actual quantities, dispatch, recipient confirmation, shortages and returns.

7. Live changes: Handle authorized last-minute amendments without overwriting completed work. Maintain revisions, alerts and acknowledgements.

8. Controls and reporting: Department handover checklists, timestamps, audit history, complaint tracing, corrective actions, daily dashboards and Excel/PDF exports.

Existing workflow documents and serving-quantity Excel are available. Approved ingredient recipes will follow after kitchen validation.

Please quote accounting/payment tracking, WhatsApp integration and client self-service separately. Explain offline capability and synchronization.

We welcome suitable low-code or custom solutions.

Your proposal must include:

- Relevant projects and recommended technology.
- Milestones, timeline and itemized development/support costs.
- Recurring fees, assumptions and exclusions.
- Security, backups, data export and ownership/handover arrangements.
- Prototypes, testing, training and documentation.

Explain how you would handle 1,000 pax across three hotels, different packing, special meals and a late headcount change.

Begin your bid with “Catering workflow understood.”

title: Создать телеграм бота с AI
description:
Нужно собрать рабочий MVP проактивного AI-бота в Telegram. В отличие от обычных чат-ботов, которые просто ждут команды, наш бот сам инициирует диалог. Запоминает контекст пользователя и периодически инициирует общение первым по заданной логике и расписанию. 
Подробное ТЗ будет предоставлено. Активное участие исполнителя и идеи улучшения будут приветствоваться. 
Ищем толкового разработчика, которому интересно собрать живой AI-продукт с нуля без костылей. 
Требования и предлагаемый стек: 
- Язык и фреймворк: Python 3.11+ (aiogram 3.x) — только чистый код, без конструкторов (Salebot/BotHelp/n8n не подходят). 
- AI-интеграция: DeepSeek API (deepseek-flash через OpenAI-совместимый SDK) с выносом ключей, модели и системных промптов в конфиг/.env. 
- БД и фоновые задачи: PostgreSQL (или Supabase) для памяти/профилей + фоновый планировщик (APScheduler / Celery) для отправки сообщений по триггерам и часовым поясам. 
- Деплой: упаковка в Docker, запуск на нашем VPS и передача Git-репозитория. 
Конфиденциальность: 
Подавая заявку и запрашивая детальное ТЗ, вы соглашаетесь не разглашать и не использовать концепцию, промпты и материалы проекта. 
В отклике напишите: 
1. Ссылку на похожих Telegram-ботов с AI в вашем портфолио. 
2. Ориентировочный бюджет и срок запуска MVP. 
3. Подтверждение готовности работать по NDA 
Ждем!

title: AI Recommendation SaaS Platform Build
description:
I’m ready to move from concept to working product on a full-stack AI SaaS platform aimed squarely at individual consumers who want personalized advice and recommendations. The core idea is simple: a clean, intuitive web app where any user can log in, describe a goal or question, and receive actionable, AI-generated guidance in real time.

What I need from you is end-to-end expertise—front-end, back-end, and the AI layer itself. I’m technology-agnostic as long as the stack is modern, scalable, and cost-efficient; React or Next.js on the front end and Python (FastAPI, Django, or similar) or Node on the back end all make sense to me. You’ll also help wire up the recommendation engine, whether that means fine-tuning an existing large language model, chaining calls through LangChain, or integrating external APIs for richer context.

Key deliverables:
• Functional web app with secure user accounts, billing hooks, and a responsive dashboard 
• Deployed, documented recommendation engine that returns tailored advice with explainable outputs 
• CI/CD pipeline plus basic analytics so I can track usage and iterate quickly

If you’ve built consumer-facing SaaS tools that lean on AI—especially anything involving personalized insights—let’s talk.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент хочет создать SaaS-платформу с ИИ для персональных рекомендаций конечным пользователям: регистрация, описание цели, советы в реальном времени, дашборд, биллинг, CI/CD и аналитика. Бюджет 3000 USD, при этом объём работ большой, поэтому нужно согласовать MVP.
analysis.reply:
You're looking to build a consumer-facing AI advisor: users log in, describe a goal, and get tailored, explainable recommendations in real time, with a dashboard, billing hooks, and analytics on top. I'd start with a Next.js front end and a FastAPI back end, and build the recommendation layer as chained LLM calls with LangChain over an existing model. That keeps costs down and holds off on fine-tuning until you have usage data to justify it. The first phase would cover auth, the core advice flow, and a basic dashboard, followed by CI/CD, analytics, and billing hooks. For an MVP within this budget, I estimate 3–4 weeks. Two questions to narrow the scope: which 2–3 advice categories should the MVP cover, and will users provide personal data (preferences, history) that the engine should draw on?

You can see live demos in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вы хотите создать ориентированного на потребителя ИИ-советника: пользователи входят в систему, описывают цель и получают персональные, объяснимые рекомендации в реальном времени, плюс дашборд, биллинг и аналитика. Я бы начал с фронтенда на Next.js и бэкенда на FastAPI, а слой рекомендаций построил бы как цепочку вызовов LLM через LangChain поверх существующей модели. title: Cross-Platform MVP Mobile App
description:

The very first thing a new user should see is an intuitive onboarding flow that lets them create an account and complete a basic profile—email or social login, profile photo, and a few custom fields. Once signed in, the app will guide them to the main feature set, which we’ll refine together while the core architecture is being built.

Here’s what I need from you:

• Secure authentication and profile management, wired to a scalable backend (Firebase, Supabase, or a lightweight custom REST/GraphQL API—open to your recommendation). 
• Clean, maintainable project structure that lets us plug in new screens as the product evolves. 
• Pixel-perfect UI that follows native guidelines, plus a design system we can extend in later sprints. 
• Basic analytics, crash reporting, and push-notification hooks so we can measure engagement from day one. 
• App Store and Google Play test builds with clear release notes and documentation.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A user can create an account, verify it, edit their profile, and log back in without errors. 
2. The same codebase compiles and passes basic QA on an iPhone and an Android phone. 
3. Source code is lint-clean, commented, and delivered in a private Git repository with a short README outlining setup and build steps. 
4. A short hand-off call or video walkthrough showing the architecture, key components, and how to extend them.

If you’re passionate about crafting polished mobile experiences and can help shape an MVP that’s ready for investor demos, let’s talk.

title: Medico-Legal Consultant (Healthcare Compliance, India)
description:
Medico-Legal Consultant

Location: India / Remote
Engagement: Part-time consultant or retainer, with scope to expand
Compensation: Based on experience and agreed scope

About the role

We are building a healthcare technology platform connecting patients with doctors, hospitals, clinics and diagnostic centres.

We need a medico-legal consultant to lead healthcare compliance, legal documentation and risk management, and manage hospital/clinic partnership agreements from initial drafting through negotiations, revisions and signing coordination.

You will work with the founders, healthcare partners, technology teams and specialist advisers.

Key responsibilities

- Healthcare compliance: Identify applicable Indian healthcare, consumer, privacy and digital-health requirements. Define the company's responsibilities and those of healthcare providers.
- Hospital and clinic agreements: Act as the primary contact for legal documents and queries. Draft/review agreements, handle revisions and negotiations, track outstanding issues and coordinate execution. Escalate significant terms to the founders for approval.
- Provider verification: Define documentation and verification requirements for doctors, hospitals, clinics and diagnostic centres.
- Patient documentation: Prepare terms of use, privacy notices, consent documents and policies covering family bookings, minors, reports and insurance information.
- Data protection: Advise on patient-data sharing, confidentiality, access, retention, deletion and incident response, including hospital-software connections.
- Payments and complaints: Review fees, cancellations, refunds, settlements, grievance handling and responsibility for failed bookings or provider cancellations.
- Advertising and reviews: Review provider claims, patient reviews, sponsored listings, rankings and promotional content.
- AI safeguards: Define appropriate boundaries, disclosures, human review and escalation for Kiro and future healthcare AI features.
- Ongoing contracts: Maintain signed agreements, amendments, renewal dates and contractual obligations. Support disputes, suspensions and terminations.
- Future services: Assess insurance processing, concierge, ambulance, medical tourism and Indian digital-health integrations before introduction.

Initial deliverables

- Prioritised medico-legal risk assessment and pre-launch action plan.
- Provider agreement templates and verification checklist.
- Patient terms, privacy notices and consent documents.
- Cancellation, refund, complaint and incident-response policies.
- Guidance on advertising, sponsored listings, reviews and AI.
- Contract tracker and a clear process for partner negotiations and approvals.

Candidate profile

- Strong experience in Indian healthcare law, medico-legal practice or healthcare compliance.
- Demonstrated ability to draft, review and negotiate healthcare agreements.
- Experience working with hospitals, clinics, diagnostic providers or digital-health companies.
- Clear communication, practical judgement and reliable follow-through.
- Ability to identify matters requiring specialist legal, clinical or regulatory advice.

Applicants should state their qualifications, professional registration where applicable and scope of practice. Candidates from medical or compliance backgrounds must demonstrate contract-management experience and explain how qualified legal counsel will support legal work where required.

How to apply

Share your CV, relevant healthcare and contract-negotiation experience, availability, proposed fees and approach to the initial assessment. Please disclose conflicts of interest and any specialist support you would require.

• A short, search-friendly product description that fits JioMart’s character limits, highlights the top benefits, and reads naturally on mobile.

Scope of items

Expect a mix of staples (e.g., rice, lentils), branded cosmetics, and popular kitchen gadgets. Accuracy on specs, pack sizes and usage tips is crucial.

Tone & style 
Keep everything friendly, clear and genuinely useful—think “helpful neighbour” rather than hard-sell. Plain language that answers common questions and highlights real-life benefits wins over jargon or hype.

Workflow & expectations 
I’ll supply product names, basic specs, images and any manufacturer notes in a spreadsheet. You research any missing details, craft the copy, and return the sheet ready for upload. Each description should pass Copyscape and meet JioMart’s formatting rules. Articles should include a SEO-aware headline, sub-headings and a gentle call-to-action pointing back to the listing.

Deliverables per SKU 
1. Listing description (80–120 words) 
2. Promotion article (300–400 words) in .docx or Google Doc 

I plan to start with 50 SKUs; if we click, the pipeline expands into the hundreds. Please share two or three live links or samples of similar e-commerce copy you’ve written, along with your turnaround time for the first batch.

title: Excel Import to PostgreSQL Table
description:
I’m holding an Excel workbook that sits on a single sheet with clear column headers and roughly ten-thousand rows of data. I need every row moved into PostgreSQL by creating a fresh table whose structure mirrors the spreadsheet exactly—same column names, same data types where practical, and no additional primary key or sequence column. 

Send back a repeatable solution (SQL, Python script, or psql commands using COPY) that I can run on my end and, if possible, a quick note showing the final row count so I can confirm nothing was missed. 

Deliverables 
• Table-creation statement matching the Excel headers 
• Import script or command set 
• Simple verification step (row total) 

Tools such as pandas, psycopg2, pgAdmin, or pure psql are fine—use what gets the job done cleanly and reliably.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужно перенести около 10 000 строк из одного листа Excel в новую таблицу PostgreSQL с такими же названиями и типами колонок, без лишнего первичного ключа. Требуется повторяемый скрипт или команды COPY и проверка количества строк.
analysis.reply:
You need a repeatable way to load a sheet of about 10,000 rows from Excel into a new PostgreSQL table that mirrors its headers and data types, with no extra key, and a row count check to confirm nothing was lost. I would read the workbook with pandas, infer column types from the data (with overrides where you need them), generate the CREATE TABLE statement from the headers, and load the rows with psycopg2 using COPY for speed. The result is a single script you run with your connection string. It prints the final row count and compares it with the sheet's row count. A working version can be ready within a day.

Two questions: do the column types need to be exact (for example, dates as timestamp and amounts as numeric), and should the table name be fixed or passed as an argument?

You can see live demos in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужен повторяемый способ загрузить лист примерно на 10 000 строк из Excel в новую таблицу PostgreSQL с теми же заголовками и типами данных, без лишнего ключа, и проверку количества строк, чтобы убедиться, что ничего не потерялось. Я бы прочитал книгу через pandas, определил типы колонок по данным (с возможностью переопределить их там, где нужно), сгенерировал CREATE TABLE по заголовкам и загрузил строки через psycopg2 с COPY для скорости. На выходе будет один скрипт, который вы запускаете со своей строкой подключения. Он выводит итоговое количество строк и сверяет его с числом строк на листе. Рабочая версия может быть готова в течение дня.

Два вопроса: нужны ли точные типы колонок (например, даты как timestamp, суммы как numeric) и должно ли имя таблицы быть фиксированным или передаваться в скрипт параметром?

title: Android & Web Finance Portal
description:
I need a unified Android app and responsive web portal for our financial-services institution. The system will be used mainly by our channel partners and in-house staff, while customers will interact through referral links that partners generate.

Core partner functions 
• Submit new customer referrals in two ways: a quick form that captures basic KYC data or a shareable referral link the customer can complete on their own. Every referral must first pass an owner-level approval step before it is activated. 
• Track individual and team business volumes, view real-time commission or payout figures, and download detailed statements. 
• See account details, status of each referred application, and a consolidated dashboard of earnings.

Staff functions 
• End-to-end management of incoming applications and partner records from a secure, role-based back office. 
• Manual override and approval controls for referral empanelment, commissions, and product disbursement stages. 
• Built-in support inbox to manage appointment requests and customer service inquiries booked through the app.

Shared customer-facing tools 
• Product catalogue with a guided application journey for loans, investments, and insurance products. 
• Appointment booking and chat/call support requests that route to the correct team automatically.

Technical notes 
The app must run smoothly on current Android versions; the web portal should be fully responsive and optimised for low-bandwidth users. A single backend (REST or GraphQL API) with JWT/OAuth security is preferred so data stays perfectly in sync across both fronts. Please factor in standard compliance items such as encrypted data at rest, audit logging, and role-based access control.

Deliverables 
1. Android APK + Play-ready bundle 
2. Responsive web application (source + deployable build) 
3. Admin panel with multi-role access 
4. Database schema & API documentation 
5. Handover of full source code, build scripts, and one round of post-launch bug fixes

If any of these details need clarification, let me know—otherwise please share your approach and timeline so we can move forward quickly.

title: Convert Scanned Notes into Spreadsheet

title: Shopify-to-Next.js Medusa Redesign
description:
My current Shopify store is ready for a full rebuild on a modern stack. I need every product, category, stock level, customer account, past order, blog post, page, image, and setting migrated cleanly into a Medusa backend and surfaced through a fast Next.js storefront.

Beyond the data move, day-to-day operations must stay seamless: customers should still check out with the same payment methods, shipping rates and tax rules must calculate exactly as they do now, and connected services—email marketing flows, reviews, subscriptions, and any other app-driven automations—need to keep firing without a hitch.

Because the brand is evolving, the frontend should not copy the old Shopify theme. Instead, craft a completely new design that feels fresh, responsive, and conversion-focused while preserving our visual identity (logos, colours, tone of voice). You are free to propose a component library or headless CMS for content management if it speeds up iteration.

Deliverables (acceptance criteria):
• Full database migration script or procedure, tested on staging, covering all selected entities 
• Next.js 14 (or latest LTS) storefront wired to Medusa, using TypeScript and server components where it makes sense 
• Working checkout with existing payment gateways, shipping/tax logic, and fulfilment webhooks verified in production mode 
• Re-integration of Klaviyo (or current ESP), reviews engine, and subscription app so all events track correctly 
• Pixel-perfect new UI/UX with lighthouse scores >90 on desktop and mobile 
• Deployment docs for Vercel or similar and hand-off training session

Timelines are negotiable, but I prefer iterative milestones: migration first, then core commerce functions, and finally the design layer. Let me know your proposed approach, stack preferences, and any similar projects you have launched with Medusa.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент хочет перенести действующий магазин со Shopify на Medusa с витриной на Next.js: товары, клиенты, заказы и контент, с сохранением оплаты, доставки, налогов и интеграций (Klaviyo, отзывы, подписки). Дизайн нужен полностью новый. Бюджет 37 500 INR при таком объёме скорее низкий.
analysis.reply:
You're looking to move a live Shopify store to Medusa with a Next.js storefront, keeping checkout, shipping and tax logic, and the Klaviyo, reviews and subscription flows working without gaps. I'd start with the migration as the first milestone: pull products, variants, stock, customers, orders and content through the Shopify API, load them into a staging Medusa instance, and check counts and order totals against the source. Next comes the storefront in Next.js 14 with TypeScript and server components, then checkout, shipping/tax rules and webhooks, and the redesign last. A realistic estimate is 1–2 weeks for the migration milestone and roughly 6–8 weeks for the full scope, depending on how many apps are connected. Which apps are currently connected to the store, and is the new design layer part of this budget or a later phase?

Live demos are in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

The project is built using Python, Streamlit, natural language processing, and a customizable knowledge base, with optional integration of local AI models through Ollama.

- Public and developer operating modes
- Developer dashboard and training center

title: Digital Product Sales Mobile App

Key elements I want built in 
• Clean, responsive UI/UX that feels native on both iOS and Android 
• Search, category filtering, wish-listing, and “buy now” checkout 
• Popular payment gateway integration (Stripe or PayPal preferred) with support for promo codes 
• Automatic licence key or file delivery once payment clears, with a protected download URL that expires after a set time 
• Purchase history and re-download option in the user profile 
• Push notifications for order confirmations, new product releases, and app updates 
• Simple admin console where I can upload files, set prices, limit download counts, and view sales analytics

Tech stack is flexible—Flutter, React Native, or fully native approaches are all acceptable as long as you explain the benefits. Please include any relevant security practices for handling files and payments, and package the full source code, build instructions, and brief documentation so I can maintain the app after launch.

Acceptance criteria 
1. App passes App Store and Google Play review guidelines. 
2. Payment flow processes test and live transactions without errors. 
3. Digital files remain accessible only to verified purchasers. 
4. All listed features function on current iOS and Android versions.

title: Excel-Driven Algo Trading Integration -- 2
description:
Hiring: Python Algo Trading Developer – Automated Options Trading System (India)

Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced Python Algo Trading Developer to develop a fully automated options trading system integrated with an Indian stockbroker through its trading API.

Preferred broker: Zerodha. However, I am open to other brokers that provide reliable API connectivity, live market data and automated order execution, subject to applicable regulatory requirements.

The system should monitor a Google Sheet (Bias_Live), identify BUY, SELL and NO TRADE signals, and automatically execute trades in the connected trading account based on predefined rules.

The developer will be provided access to the Google Sheet for signal integration.

1. Trading Configuration

* Market: Indian stock market.
* Trading segment: Options buying.
* Instruments: All eligible indices and selected individual stocks with options contracts.
* BUY signal: Automatically buy ATM Call Option (CE).
* SELL signal: Automatically buy ATM Put Option (PE).
* NO TRADE: No order execution.
* Strike selection: ATM.
* Expiry selection: Based on liquidity and strategy.
* Execution: Fully automated, subject to applicable regulatory and broker approvals.

2. Required Functionalities

A. Automated Signal Monitoring

* Continuously monitor BUY/SELL/NO TRADE signals from Google Sheets.
* Identify eligible trading opportunities.
* Avoid duplicate entries.
* Validate signal freshness before placing orders.

B. Automated Order Execution

* Integrate with Zerodha Kite Connect or another suitable Indian broker API.
* Automatically select the appropriate CE/PE contract.
* Select ATM strike and suitable expiry.
* Check liquidity, volume, open interest and bid/ask spread.
* Calculate quantity based on available capital and risk limits.
* Place and verify orders automatically.
* Handle rejected, pending and partially filled orders.

C. Risk Management

* Percentage-based stop-loss.
* Configurable trailing stop-loss.
* Configurable profit targets.
* Automatic exit on opposite signals or predefined exit conditions.
* Position sizing based on available capital.
* Maximum daily loss limit.
* Maximum simultaneous open positions.
* Emergency stop mechanism.

D. Trade Monitoring

* Live P&L monitoring.
* Open positions and order status.
* Entry and exit prices.
* Stop-loss and target tracking.
* Automated position closure.
* Complete trade history and transaction logs.
* Notifications for entries, exits, errors and risk-limit breaches.

E. Trading Dashboard

Develop a dashboard displaying:

* Available capital.
* Invested capital.
* Daily realized and unrealized P&L.
* Active positions.
* Trading signals.
* Order execution status.
* Stop-loss and target levels.
* Daily trade summary.
* System and broker connection status.

3. Technical Requirements

* Python programming.
* Zerodha Kite Connect or equivalent Indian broker API.
* Real-time market data through WebSocket or equivalent.
* Google Sheets API integration.
* SQLite or equivalent database.
* Automated error handling and recovery.
* Secure authentication and token management.
* Static IP and applicable exchange/broker compliance requirements.
* Reliable execution without duplicate orders.

title: Desktop Thermometer App Field Trial(only from Uk) -
description:
Join CoolRater’s winter 2026–27 field trial of a Windows app that measures the Heat-Transfer Coefficient of your home, a statistic used to support heat-pump sizing. Participants will install the app, connect an Octopus Energy account, provide half-hourly smart-meter data, and collect overnight temperatures using four Elitech RC-5+ loggers, which will be provided. Applicants must heat their home with a gas boiler and avoid using energy outside the home during trial sessions. Basic computer skills are sufficient; CSV editing and installing unsigned trial software are required. Five participants are sought each month from November 2026 to February 2027. 

CoolRater is a desktop app which will measure the heat transfer coefficient HTC for a building, a function that has become increasingly important in recent years for use in sizing heat pumps. A field trial is being run this winter with these objectives: 

1. To obtain temperature and energy data for a range of properties. Currently CoolRater has only been used for the author’s own property. 

2. to obtain data from properties where the temperature varies between locations due to variations in insulation or heat distribution. For example close to a solid floor with no insulation, or in rooms which do not have double glazing. 

3. To find out if users have any problems in using the app, or have any dislikes or need for additional features or improvements. 

There are some specific requirements for participants: 

1. The app only supports Windows (10 or 11); 
2. heating must be with a gas boiler; 
3. your energy supplier must be Octopus Energy, and you must be able to connect to the Octopus API, which means that you will have to live in the UK. 
4. you must have a smart meter, configured to record energy use every 30 minutes. As a quick check that the smart meter and API is working correctly, there is a feature on the Octopus website where you can download smart meter data. Log in to your Octopus account, click your name top right, click My Energy, scroll down to "Get your energy geek on" you can download files of energy usage. Please download two days of energy data and attach it to your proposal, so that I can see that you have a working smart meter. 
5. during the trial, which is only active at night, you will not be able to use energy for anything outside the house, like charging EVs. 

To collect the temperature data you will be provided with four Elitech RC-5+ logging thermometers. To send you these, I will need your address. Exchanging contact details is discouraged by PPH rules, but is allowed after a proposal has been accepted if it is necessary to mail equipment. Note that a similar project is also posted which differs only in that participants buy their own thermometers, receive a higher amount as a result, and do not therefore need to provide their address. 

A high level of computer expertise is not required but you will need to copy your API key from your Octopus account to the app, you may need to edit CSV files with Excel or LibraOffice, and install the app. As trial software it has not been possible to digitally sign it and it has had few downloads. Therefore the operating system will treat it with suspicion and advise you not to run it. You can run it against this advice by clicking “More Information” and “Run Anyway”. 

The video https://youtu.be/HryknL9LGqQ gives instructions on using the app and shows what you will need to do as a participant in the field trial. 

Criteria for Job Completion 

As trial software its difficult to be certain of how well it will work. The app calculates the HTC for each inside thermometer by three different methods. If for any one of the thermometers the results agree to within 10%, then jobs a good’un. If they don’t, then this often indicates a problem with the thermometer being close to a heating source. So I would like you to repeat the test one or two times to get a better result. Return either one project file with the results agreeing to within 10%, or three project files from three separate attempts. 

It is intended that there will be five participants in each of the months November 2026 to February 2027.

title: WordPress Speed & Stability Boost
description:
My Lightsail-hosted site, tek1.com.au, has started dragging its feet. Pages and even the WordPress admin back end often take far too long to appear, and every so often the whole site simply drops offline without warning. The slowdowns and outages hit at random, so I can’t just schedule maintenance windows or blame traffic spikes.

Everything runs on the usual stack—WordPress with MariaDB and Apache behind Cloudflare. I’ve already enabled basic Cloudflare caching, but the gains are inconsistent. I suspect thread limits, database tuning, and Cloudflare worker rules all need a fresh set of expert eyes. What I need is a methodical optimisation that:

• Keeps the Lightsail instance stable (no crashes during tuning). 
• Brings consistent load times across the entire site, including wp-admin. 
• Uses smart caching and connection limits so random outages disappear.

Feel free to tap into tools you trust—php-fpm configs, MariaDB index tweaks, Apache MPM, Cloudflare cache rules, or custom workers—as long as each change is documented so I can maintain it later.

Deliverables 
• A before-and-after performance report (GTmetrix or WebPageTest plus server metrics). 
• Updated configs/scripts applied on the server and saved to a repo or text file. 
• A brief hand-over note outlining what was changed and how to revert if needed.

If you’ve solved similar WordPress + Lightsail + Cloudflare headaches before, I’d like to hear how you tackled them and how quickly we can repeat that success here.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент просит найти и устранить случайные замедления и отключения WordPress-сайта tek1.com.au на Lightsail за Cloudflare: настроить PHP-FPM, MariaDB, Apache MPM и правила кеширования без простоя, с отчетом до/после и документацией по откату. Бюджет 750 AUD, задача сложная и инфраструктурная.
analysis.reply:
You're seeing random slowdowns and full outages on a WordPress site on Lightsail behind Cloudflare, and you want the cause found and fixed without taking the site down during tuning. My plan is to start with a baseline in WebPageTest and check the server logs, PHP-FPM and MariaDB usage to find what actually triggers the drops. Then I'd adjust PHP-FPM worker limits, MariaDB settings and indexes, Apache MPM and Cloudflare cache rules, one change at a time, with a backup and a documented revert step for each. You'd get the before-and-after report, the config files in a repo, and a hand-over note. I estimate 1 to 2 weeks, depending on what the logs show. Two questions: do you have SSH and WordPress admin access, and roughly how much RAM does the instance have? Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вы замечаете случайные замедления и полные отключения WordPress-сайта на Lightsail за Cloudflare и хотите найти причину и устранить её без простоя во время настройки. Мой план: начать с базовых замеров в WebPageTest и проверить серверные логи, использование PHP-FPM и MariaDB, чтобы понять, что именно вызывает сбои. title: WooCommerce Gift Booking Cart Setup

The catalogue will contain:
• Physical gifts that ship to the customer 
• The same items offered as personalised versions

For each personalised product the cart must let the buyer:
• Enter custom text (names, dates, short messages) 
• Upload a photo for print-on-gift options 
• Pick from preset colours, sizes, or design variations

Those inputs need to travel cleanly from product page through checkout and into the admin order details and emails so my fulfilment team sees them without extra clicks. If an upload is required, the file should be stored in the media library and linked in the order.

Scope of work 
1. Configure WooCommerce (latest stable) on my existing WordPress install. 
2. Design or adapt a product template that surfaces all the personalisation fields above while keeping UX simple on mobile. 
3. Add a calendar/date picker so the customer can choose their preferred delivery date. 
4. Set up shipping rules for physical gifts (flat rate, weight-based, and free-over-threshold). 
5. Ensure the cart, checkout and order confirmation emails display every custom option clearly. 
6. Test the full flow—guest checkout, account checkout, and edge cases such as missing required text or oversized image uploads.

Acceptance criteria 
• A new product can be created in the dashboard, assigned any mix of the three personalisation options, and published without touching code. 
• Orders arrive in WooCommerce with all custom data visible in one place. 
• Checkout works with the currently active payment gateway (Stripe). 
• Core functionality remains inside WordPress/WooCommerce; any extra plugins must be reputable, actively maintained, and kept lightweight.

If you have experience with plugins like Product Add-Ons, Advanced Upload or similar, tell me which you plan to use so we keep maintenance straightforward.

title: Desktop Thermometer App Field Trial(only from Uk) -- 2
description:
Join CoolRater’s winter 2026–27 field trial of a Windows app that measures the Heat-Transfer Coefficient of your home, a statistic used to support heat-pump sizing. Participants will install the app, connect an Octopus Energy account, provide half-hourly smart-meter data, and collect overnight temperatures using four Elitech RC-5+ loggers, which will be provided. Applicants must heat their home with a gas boiler and avoid using energy outside the home during trial sessions. Basic computer skills are sufficient; CSV editing and installing unsigned trial software are required. Five participants are sought each month from November 2026 to February 2027. 

CoolRater is a desktop app which will measure the heat transfer coefficient HTC for a building, a function that has become increasingly important in recent years for use in sizing heat pumps. A field trial is being run this winter with these objectives: 

1. To obtain temperature and energy data for a range of properties. Currently CoolRater has only been used for the author’s own property. 

2. to obtain data from properties where the temperature varies between locations due to variations in insulation or heat distribution. For example close to a solid floor with no insulation, or in rooms which do not have double glazing. 

3. To find out if users have any problems in using the app, or have any dislikes or need for additional features or improvements. 

There are some specific requirements for participants: 

1. The app only supports Windows (10 or 11); 
2. heating must be with a gas boiler; 
3. your energy supplier must be Octopus Energy, and you must be able to connect to the Octopus API, which means that you will have to live in the UK. 
4. you must have a smart meter, configured to record energy use every 30 minutes. As a quick check that the smart meter and API is working correctly, there is a feature on the Octopus website where you can download smart meter data. Log in to your Octopus account, click your name top right, click My Energy, scroll down to "Get your energy geek on" you can download files of energy usage. Please download two days of energy data and attach it to your proposal, so that I can see that you have a working smart meter. 
5. during the trial, which is only active at night, you will not be able to use energy for anything outside the house, like charging EVs. 

To collect the temperature data you will be provided with four Elitech RC-5+ logging thermometers. To send you these, I will need your address. Exchanging contact details is discouraged by PPH rules, but is allowed after a proposal has been accepted if it is necessary to mail equipment. Note that a similar project is also posted which differs only in that participants buy their own thermometers, receive a higher amount as a result, and do not therefore need to provide their address. 

A high level of computer expertise is not required but you will need to copy your API key from your Octopus account to the app, you may need to edit CSV files with Excel or LibraOffice, and install the app. As trial software it has not been possible to digitally sign it and it has had few downloads. Therefore the operating system will treat it with suspicion and advise you not to run it. You can run it against this advice by clicking “More Information” and “Run Anyway”. 

The video https://youtu.be/HryknL9LGqQ gives instructions on using the app and shows what you will need to do as a participant in the field trial. 

Criteria for Job Completion 

As trial software its difficult to be certain of how well it will work. The app calculates the HTC for each inside thermometer by three different methods. If for any one of the thermometers the results agree to within 10%, then jobs a good’un. If they don’t, then this often indicates a problem with the thermometer being close to a heating source. So I would like you to repeat the test one or two times to get a better result. Return either one project file with the results agreeing to within 10%, or three project files from three separate attempts. 

It is intended that there will be five participants in each of the months November 2026 to February 2027.

title: Batch Quiz Question Generator
description:
I need an automated workflow that takes a list of topics and sub-topics I will supply and produces roughly 2,000–2,500 multiple-choice questions through a batch API call. Every item must contain the prompt, four answer options, the single correct answer, and a concise explanation (one or two sentences) to justify the correct choice.

My ideal solution is a script or small application that reads a structured input file (CSV, JSON, or Google Sheet—whichever you find most efficient), feeds each row into the API, and then writes the returned questions to an export format I can easily review and import into my LMS. The system has to respect rate limits, handle retries gracefully, and keep the topic hierarchy intact so I can trace each generated question back to its parent sub-topic.

I will provide:

• A master list of topics and sub-topics, each tagged with a unique ID. 
• Style guidelines for wording and difficulty. 
• API credentials for the chosen model.

Deliverables:

1. Well-documented code (Python preferred, but I’m open) that performs batch generation and export. 
2. A README with setup instructions and an example input file. 
3. One sample run that shows at least 25 questions covering different sub-topics, confirming formatting and explanation length.

Acceptance criteria:

• Questions strictly follow the four-option MCQ structure with one correct answer and an explanation. 
• Output passes a quick duplication check (no identical or near-identical questions). 
• Script completes a full 2,000-question batch without unhandled errors.

If you have experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or similar large-scale text generation via API and can turn this around efficiently, let’s talk.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен скрипт для пакетной генерации около 2000–2500 тестовых вопросов с четырьмя вариантами ответа и пояснением по списку тем и подтем через API языковой модели. Скрипт должен учитывать rate limits, повторять неудачные запросы, проверять дубликаты и экспортировать результат для импорта в LMS. Бюджет низкий (1500 INR) при большом объёме работы.
analysis.reply:
You need a batch pipeline that turns your topic tree into about 2,000 four-option MCQs with short explanations, with retries, rate limiting and an export you can trace back to each sub-topic. I'd build it in Python: read topics from CSV or JSON with their IDs, send requests concurrently under a rate limiter with exponential backoff, validate each response against a strict schema (four options, one correct answer, a one-to-two sentence explanation), and run a normalized-text similarity check to catch near-duplicates before writing the CSV/JSON output with the parent sub-topic ID. Using a modern stack and AI-assisted development, I can deliver the script, README and a sample run of 25+ questions within about 3–4 days. Which model provider will you use, and what import format does your LMS expect? Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/
Yakov

title: Android Coin Toss Game Rs15000
description:
I want a lightweight, Android-only game where users bet virtual coins on a simple Heads-or-Tails toss. Every new account—whether created with mobile-OTP or Google sign-in—should automatically start with 100 free coins. 

Core game flow 
• Player selects Head or Tail, the animated coin flips, and the result appears instantly. 
• Winnings follow a custom payout I’ll set in the admin panel; losses remove the staked coins. 
• Toss outcomes stay fair yet profitable because I’ll be able to define a global win-percentage rather than deciding each toss manually. 

Player features 
• Real-time coin balance updates. 
• History screen showing the last ten tosses. 
• Leaderboard displaying the top coin holders. 

Admin panel 
From a web or in-app console I need to: 
• Adjust any user’s coin balance. 
• Set or tweak the overall win percentage. 
• Change the payout multiplier. 
• View all registered players, their histories, and basic analytics. 

Deliverables 
1. Production-ready APK. 
2. Full, well-commented source code that opens in Android Studio. 
3. Simple admin panel (web or mobile) with the controls listed above. 
4. Short setup guide so I can rebuild, publish, and maintain the project myself. 

Timeline is 7–10 days, fixed budget ₹15,000. Please include at least one previous game APK in your bid so I can check animation quality and performance.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет нативную Android-игру «орёл или решка» на виртуальные монеты с админ-панелью, где можно задавать глобальный процент выигрышей и множитель выплат. Проект требует APK и исходники для Android Studio, а не веб-разработки из списка услуг, и предполагает скрытое управление исходами игры.

title: Short Film Sound & Foley Design
description:
