I’m editing in Premiere but can supply an AAF/OMF along with reference tracks and a detailed spotting sheet. Feel free to work in Pro Tools, Reaper, or your preferred DAW—as long as the final stems line up perfectly when I drop them back into the timeline.

Deliverables (acceptance criteria) 
• Separate, fully-mixed stems: 
 – Dialogue 
 – Music 
 – Sound effects / Foley 
• All stems synced frame-accurately to the locked picture (24 fps). 
• Session file or full track-lay for future revisions. 
• Peak-legal mix that translates to cinema, web, and social without additional limiting.

If this sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s discuss turnaround and any creative ideas you’d like to bring to the project.

title: Shopify Website Design Rebrand
description:
I’m refreshing the look and feel of my existing Shopify store and want a designer-developer who can overhaul the site’s visual design while keeping all current products, pages, and functionality in place. 

Scope 
The focus is the front-end only—logo and product photography stay as they are. I already have a defined color palette and will share the HEX values once we get started. Your job is to weave those colors into a cohesive redesign, update the typography for better readability and brand consistency, and restructure the layout so the store feels fresh, modern, and conversion-friendly. 

What I’m expecting 
• A polished mock-up (Figma, Adobe XD, or similar) showing new color scheme, type hierarchy, and revised page sections for Home, Collection, Product, Cart, and Checkout. 
• Implementation of the approved design directly in Shopify using theme customization, Liquid, CSS, and any lightweight JavaScript where necessary. 
• Mobile responsiveness tested across major devices and browsers. 
• Handoff with documentation covering any new templates, snippets, or settings you create so I can maintain the look long-term. 

I’ll supply the palette and existing brand guidelines as soon as we kick off. Let’s make the store look as premium as the products it sells.

analysis.summary_ru: Редизайн существующего Shopify-магазина: новая цветовая палитра, типографика и структура страниц (главная, коллекция, товар, корзина, оформление заказа) при сохранении товаров и функционала. Нужны макет в Figma, внедрение в теме и документация. Бюджет 30 USD, что мало для такого объёма.
analysis.reply:
You want the Shopify store restyled on the front end: a new palette, typography, and layout across Home, Collection, Product, Cart and Checkout, with products, pages and functionality left untouched. I'd build it directly in your theme using Liquid, CSS and light JavaScript, and package the custom sections and snippets with documented settings so the look is easy to maintain. I'd start with a quick visual direction based on your HEX values, then implement template by template and test on mobile and desktop browsers. For this scope I'd estimate about 5–7 days. Two things to confirm: which theme you're on now, and whether you need a full Figma mock-up approved before coding, or whether screenshots and a short style guide would be enough to fit the budget?

Live demos of my work: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

Вы хотите обновить внешний вид магазина на Shopify на уровне фронтенда: новая палитра, типографика и структура страниц для главной, коллекции, товара, корзины и оформления заказа. Товары, страницы и функционал остаются без изменений. Я бы реализовал дизайн прямо в вашей теме на Liquid, CSS и небольшом JavaScript и оформил новые секции и сниппеты с документацией по настройкам, чтобы стиль было легко поддерживать. Сначала я бы предложил визуальное направление на основе ваших HEX-значений, затем внедрял бы шаблон за шаблоном и тестировал на мобильных устройствах и десктопных браузерах. По такому объёму я оцениваю срок примерно в 5–7 дней. title: Modern Facebook Page Rebrand & Graphics
description:
I’m ready to give my Shopify-driven e-commerce brand a fresh, cohesive look on Facebook and need your creative expertise to make it happen. The goal is simple: overhaul every visual and tonal touchpoint so new visitors instantly recognize the brand and existing followers feel the upgrade—ultimately lifting overall awareness.

Here’s what I need from you:

• A clean, modern, minimalistic profile image and matching cover that translate well across desktop and mobile 
• A refreshed page theme and layout guide (fonts, color palette, post styling) that aligns with our Shopify storefront branding 
• A small batch of post templates or sample posts demonstrating the new look, so my team can keep the style consistent after hand-off 

Because the brand centers on e-commerce, please keep conversion-friendly design principles in mind—clear CTAs, uncluttered visuals, and product-forward imagery. Final artwork should come in layered/source files (PSD or AI) plus ready-to-upload PNG/JPEG versions. 

I’ll share current brand assets, products, and page analytics once we kick off. If you have a portfolio of Facebook or Shopify-related rebrands, that will help me decide quickly.

title: Urgent School Information Website
description:
Our school needs a clean, modern website built as soon as possible so we can share news, events, and key announcements with our community. The core of the site will be an easy-to-update content management system—WordPress, Joomla, or another comparable platform is fine as long as staff with basic tech skills can add posts, images, and calendar items without calling a developer every time.

Key sections we have in mind are an “About Us” overview, dedicated pages for news, events, staff profiles, a gallery, and a contact page with a simple enquiry form. Responsive design is non-negotiable because many parents use their phones first; accessibility best practices matter too.

I’m inviting detailed project proposals that outline:
• your recommended tech stack or theme,
• a realistic, fast-track timeline (remember, I need this ASAP),
• any design approach or wireframes you can sketch quickly,
• post-launch support you include.

Deliverables must be a fully functioning live site, placeholder content swapped for our final copy, and a short admin guide so staff can handle routine updates. If you need further information on branding assets or hosting credentials, let me know and I’ll provide them right away. I’m ready to move forward immediately once I see a solid, time-bound plan.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен срочный современный сайт школы с простой CMS для новостей, мероприятий, галереи и сотрудников, адаптивный и доступный. Бюджет очень низкий (1500 INR), но задача хорошо подходит под быструю сборку на готовом шаблоне.
analysis.reply:
You need a fast, mobile-first school website where non-technical staff can publish news, events and gallery items on their own. I would build it on a proven CMS theme (WordPress or a similar platform) with About, News, Events, Staff, Gallery and Contact pages, then adapt it to your branding and cover accessibility basics such as contrast, alt text and keyboard navigation. Once I have your copy, images and hosting access, I can deliver a live staging version in about 2-3 days and the final site with a short admin guide in roughly 4-5 days. Do you already have a domain and hosting, and how many staff members will need editing access? You can see similar live demos here: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

title: Análisis NOM-035 en Excel -- 2 MEXICO ESPAÑOL
description:
Necesito apoyo para procesar 120 respuestas de mis cuestionarios NOM-035 (Guía I y Guía III). Te compartiré acceso directo a la hoja de respuestas en Google Forms; desde allí deberás:

• Exportar, organizar y limpiar toda la información. 
• Calcular puntajes por dominio y asignar niveles de riesgo para cada persona. 
• Entregarme ambos: Excel completo y reporte resumido. 

Para el reporte necesito exactamente lo siguiente: Tablas y gráficas y resumen ejecutivo con hallzgos. Incluye recomendaciones generales que ayuden a interpretar los niveles de riesgo.

Otros detalles importantes: 
– Mantén absoluta confidencialidad de los datos individuales. 
– El archivo final en Excel debe quedar listo para filtrar y segmentar por dominio, nivel de riesgo y área. 
– Las gráficas pueden elaborarse en Excel o Google Sheets, siempre que sean claras y se actualicen con los datos. 
– En el resumen ejecutivo destaca patrones relevantes y posibles acciones de mejora.

Busco a alguien con manejo sólido de Excel avanzado (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas, formato condicional) y familiaridad con Google Forms/Sheets. Si ya has trabajado con NOM-035 o encuestas de clima laboral, menciónalo: sumarás puntos.

Adjunta un ejemplo breve de reporte similar o describe tu metodología para validar que dominas el proceso.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент просит обработать 120 ответов из Google Forms по опросникам NOM-035, посчитать баллы и уровни риска, а также подготовить таблицы, графики и резюме. По сути это ручная аналитика и подготовка отчёта в Excel, а не разработка программного продукта или автоматизации.

title: Forensic Shadow Analysis & Report by EOD Sunday, 29th November.
description:
I am preparing expert evidence for an upcoming matter in New South Wales, Australia and need a forensic-imagery specialist for a very simple ask that relates to a small subset of frames extracted from a short .MOV. 

Your brief is to determine: 
•whether the shadow length of a garbage bin in the object is consistent with the recorded time and GPS location.

You will receive the original .MOV and the example frame - but will be expected to hash the MOV and create the frames yourself, documenting your steps such that repetition is allowed. Complete metadata and binary examinations have already been performed, so no repeat work is required there.

Deliverable 1: assesment of each of the frames and assessment of capture timing as outlaid below
Deliverable 2 (dependent on deliverable 1): If your findings show a capturer v .MOV metadata mismatach you can stand by by explaining how you came to your result (and how any findings re your shadow assessment can be assured as being distinct from encoding), I will require court-ready expert report that meets NSW evidentiary standards, that clearly sets out methodology, findings, and your professional opinion on each of the above points including the professional tools used (e.g., Amped FIVE, Photoshop Forensics, MATLAB, Sun-position calculators), and any assumptions that must be documented for the court.

Index of checks required and 'Opinion' on whether the observations could be naturally occurring in a live.photo to MOV re-endcode. 
frame_0004.jpg, Opinion: next to the approaching white sedan, to the rear of the white parked white van, there is a green wheelie bin / large green trash bin. Assess if the shadow appears to be symmetrical to the bin itself. Assess the shadow's length (at the point of truncation by the approaching VW) for the February date and time in the MOV's metadata. 

Trigonometry capability is also advantageous given the calculation of the shadow lengths observed and expected would require it. 

I am happy to pay a premium if certifications or qualifications that would strengthen the report are held. If you do not hold such qualifications / certifications, I will remain at the lower end of the budget window.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент ищет судебного эксперта по forensic-анализу изображений: проверить, соответствует ли длина тени от мусорного бака времени и GPS-координатам съёмки, и подготовить экспертное заключение для суда в Новом Южном Уэльсе. Это экспертная работа, а не разработка.
questions: Нужна ли здесь разработка программного инструмента для расчёта длины тени, или заказчику требуется именно экспертное заключение специалиста по forensic-изображениям?

title: Google CASA Verification Support
description:
I have a working web app (PHP + MySQL, hosted on Hostinger, live at portal.blindforward.in). Clients sign in with Google and approve the gmail.readonly scope. The server then forwards selected emails to their accountant. The app does not store any email content.

The app is already built and working. I only need help with Google's verification and the CASA (Cloud Application Security Assessment) Tier 2 step. I do not need a new build.

What I need:
1. Review my app against the CASA Tier checklist and tell me what will fail.
2. Fix any security findings in the PHP code and server setup (HTTPS/headers, session and cookie security, input validation, token encryption, secrets handling).
3. Guide me through the scan with a Google-authorized CASA assessor (such as TAC Security or NetSentries), fix the scan findings, and get the final validation letter.
4. Help me submit correctly in Google Cloud Console (scope justification, demo video, privacy policy) until restricted-scope verification is approved.

Please bid only if you have done Google OAuth verification or CASA before. Share a short example of a similar project.

Payment: fixed price in milestones: (1) gap review and fix list, (2) fixes done and scan passed, (3) Google verification approved.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент просит проверить существующее PHP/MySQL-приложение с доступом к gmail.readonly, исправить проблемы безопасности и помочь пройти Google CASA Tier 2 и верификацию ограниченных scope. Новая разработка не нужна. Требование клиента: исполнитель уже должен был проходить Google OAuth-верификацию или CASA.

Then I'd fix the code and server issues you listed: HTTPS and security headers, session and cookie flags, input validation, encryption of stored OAuth tokens, and moving secrets out of the codebase. To be clear, I haven't gone through Google OAuth verification or a CASA assessment myself, so I'd only take the technical hardening and leave the assessor and submission steps to you or a specialist you trust. Could you share read access to the codebase? Have you already booked an assessor?

title: Informational Lead-Generation Website Build
description:
I’m ready to commission a clean, modern website that showcases my business and turns visitors into genuine enquiries. The site’s core purpose is to present who we are, what we do and—most importantly—make it effortless for potential customers to reach out.

Here’s what I have in mind:
• A polished, mobile-responsive layout that quickly communicates our value. 
• Clear calls-to-action on every page—prominent contact details, enquiry form and clickable phone/email links. 
• Key sections: homepage, services or portfolio overview, about us, testimonials and a dedicated contact page. 
• Fast loading, SEO-friendly structure and Google Analytics set-up so I can track enquiry sources. 
• Simple content management (WordPress, Webflow or another intuitive CMS) so I can update text and images myself after launch.

title: Desktop Thermometer App Field Trial(only from Uk)
description:
Join CoolRater’s winter 2026–27 field trial of a Windows app that measures the Heat-Transfer Coefficient of your home, a statistic used to support heat-pump sizing. Participants will install the app, connect an Octopus Energy account, provide half-hourly smart-meter data, and collect overnight temperatures using four Elitech RC-5+ loggers, which will be provided. Applicants must heat their home with a gas boiler and avoid using energy outside the home during trial sessions. Basic computer skills are sufficient; CSV editing and installing unsigned trial software are required. Five participants are sought each month from November 2026 to February 2027. 

CoolRater is a desktop app which will measure the heat transfer coefficient HTC for a building, a function that has become increasingly important in recent years for use in sizing heat pumps. A field trial is being run this winter with these objectives: 

1. To obtain temperature and energy data for a range of properties. Currently CoolRater has only been used for the author’s own property. 

2. to obtain data from properties where the temperature varies between locations due to variations in insulation or heat distribution. For example close to a solid floor with no insulation, or in rooms which do not have double glazing. 

3. To find out if users have any problems in using the app, or have any dislikes or need for additional features or improvements. 

There are some specific requirements for participants: 

1. The app only supports Windows (10 or 11); 
2. heating must be with a gas boiler; 
3. your energy supplier must be Octopus Energy, and you must be able to connect to the Octopus API, which means that you will have to live in the UK. 
4. you must have a smart meter, configured to record energy use every 30 minutes. As a quick check that the smart meter and API is working correctly, there is a feature on the Octopus website where you can download smart meter data. Log in to your Octopus account, click your name top right, click My Energy, scroll down to "Get your energy geek on" you can download files of energy usage. Please download two days of energy data and attach it to your proposal, so that I can see that you have a working smart meter. 
5. during the trial, which is only active at night, you will not be able to use energy for anything outside the house, like charging EVs. 

To collect the temperature data you will be provided with four Elitech RC-5+ logging thermometers. To send you these, I will need your address. Exchanging contact details is discouraged by PPH rules, but is allowed after a proposal has been accepted if it is necessary to mail equipment. Note that a similar project is also posted which differs only in that participants buy their own thermometers, receive a higher amount as a result, and do not therefore need to provide their address. 

A high level of computer expertise is not required but you will need to copy your API key from your Octopus account to the app, you may need to edit CSV files with Excel or LibraOffice, and install the app. As trial software it has not been possible to digitally sign it and it has had few downloads. Therefore the operating system will treat it with suspicion and advise you not to run it. You can run it against this advice by clicking “More Information” and “Run Anyway”. 

The video https://youtu.be/HryknL9LGqQ gives instructions on using the app and shows what you will need to do as a participant in the field trial. 

Criteria for Job Completion 

As trial software its difficult to be certain of how well it will work. The app calculates the HTC for each inside thermometer by three different methods. If for any one of the thermometers the results agree to within 10%, then jobs a good’un. If they don’t, then this often indicates a problem with the thermometer being close to a heating source. So I would like you to repeat the test one or two times to get a better result. Return either one project file with the results agreeing to within 10%, or three project files from three separate attempts. 

It is intended that there will be five participants in each of the months November 2026 to February 2027.

analysis.summary_ru: Это не проект разработки, а набор участников для полевого испытания программы CoolRater: нужно жить в Великобритании, отапливать дом газовым котлом, иметь счётчик Octopus Energy и собирать ночные данные о температуре с выданными термометрами.

title: n8n E-Commerce Reporting Automation
description:
I’m ready to move all of my daily data wrangling into n8n. Your task is to wire my website, Shopify store, and on-premise ERP (REST API + direct SQL access) into a single automated flow that emails me clean PDF or spreadsheet reports without any manual touch.

The first milestone is clear: every morning I should receive a report that covers 
• sales totals, best-selling products, and order numbers 
• current stock levels with low-stock alerts and “reorder now” flags 
• customer details, returns, and live order status 

How you get there is up to you, but I expect well-structured n8n workflows, solid error handling, and clear documentation of every credential, webhook, and SQL query you add. Once the core reporting is solid, I’d like to see a second phase where an AI step (e.g., OpenAI or similar) reads the numbers, highlights unusual trends, and suggests next actions.

Deliverables 
1. Exported n8n workflow files (.json) ready to import 
2. Sample PDF and XLSX reports matching the three data sections above 
3. A short setup guide so I can maintain and extend the flows myself 

If you’ve already connected Shopify or ERP systems through n8n, or have built AI-driven analytics on top of them, tell me how you approached it—I value proven shortcuts over reinventing the wheel.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент хочет автоматизировать ежедневные отчёты в n8n: объединить сайт, Shopify и локальную ERP (REST API и прямой SQL), чтобы каждое утро получать на почту PDF или XLSX с продажами, остатками и статусами заказов. Вторым этапом нужен ИИ-анализ трендов и рекомендаций.
analysis.reply:
You want the morning numbers (sales, stock, orders, returns) to arrive in your inbox automatically, pulled from Shopify, your website, and an ERP you reach through both REST and direct SQL. I'd build this as modular n8n workflows: one branch per source, a normalization step, then the three report sections rendered to PDF and XLSX and emailed on a schedule. Error handling would cover API rate limits, failed SQL connections, and alerts when a source returns no data, and I'd document every credential, webhook, and query so you can maintain it yourself. The core reporting milestone should take about a week, with the AI trend-analysis phase following once the reports are stable.

Could you confirm which ERP and database engine you run? Also, is Shopify access through a custom app or a private token?

Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вы хотите, чтобы утренние цифры (продажи, остатки, заказы, возвраты) автоматически приходили вам на почту. Данные берутся из Shopify, вашего сайта и ERP, к которой вы подключаетесь и через REST API, и через прямой SQL. Я бы построил это как модульные воркфлоу n8n: отдельная ветка для каждого источника, шаг нормализации данных, затем три раздела отчёта, которые формируются в PDF и XLSX и отправляются на почту по расписанию. Обработка ошибок будет покрывать лимиты API, сбои SQL-подключения и уведомления, если источник не вернул данных. Каждый credential, webhook и запрос я задокументирую, чтобы вы могли поддерживать систему самостоятельно. title: Android Vedic Astrology App
description:
I’m looking to release a lightweight Android application that lets users request Vedic astrology (Kundli) consultations and pay dakshina directly inside the app. Within the limited budget I have set aside for this first version, I want to focus on the features that matter most to the experience while keeping the codebase clean enough for future expansion.

Core user flow 
• Visitor installs the app, registers with mobile OTP and accepts Privacy Policy / T&C. 
• On the home screen the two service options are shown: ₹501 for a general or all-question analysis and ₹1999 for a full birth-chart reading. 
• The client taps their choice, fills the intake form (name, date, time & place of birth, plus an open question box) and scans a UPI QR displayed on the next screen. 
• They enter the UTR / transaction ID and tap “Submit”. 
• Once payment is verified, a private chat window opens. In that chat they can send text, photos and voice notes; I can reply in the same way. No video or live call is needed for this MVP. 
• Users can review previous consultations from a simple “My Sessions” tab.

Admin side 
A lightweight web-based (or in-app) admin panel is enough. It should list new inquiries, indicate which ones have paid, and let me answer directly inside the chat thread. A dashboard counter for “New”, “In Progress”, “Closed” would help me stay organised.

Security & compliance 
OTP login, Firebase or similar secure auth, and local encryption of the birth-detail form data are essential. I will provide final wording for Privacy Policy and Terms so they appear during sign-up.

Deliverables (MVP) 
1. Android APK + source code structured for future Play Store release. 
2. Intake form with validation and UPI payment screen. 
3. Real-time chat (text, image, voice note) between user and admin. 
4. Simple admin panel with status filters and reply capability. 
5. Basic notification setup (FCM) so I see new messages instantly. 
6. Installation guide and short hand-off call.

Kindly outline: 
• Which ready-made chat or backend service you’ll use (e.g., Firebase Realtime DB, Firestore, or your own Node.js server) to stay within budget. 
• Approximate timeline for an install-ready APK. 
• Any third-party costs aside from my Play Console fee.

I’m happy to clarify edge cases, but if you can hit the above scope within the stated budget and timeframe, let’s move ahead quickly.

Бюджет 12 500 INR заметно ниже объёма работ.

title: Backend Enhancement & AWS Optimization

In parallel, we will lean on AWS. I want data stored securely (think S3, KMS, or an encrypted RDS setup), plus an architecture that can scale smoothly when traffic spikes. Reliability matters, so automated backups, CloudWatch monitoring, and alerting need to be in place from day one.

Deliverables I will use to sign off the project: 
• Updated database design and migration scripts 
• Refactored or extended backend code that plugs into the new data layer 
• AWS configuration (Terraform or CloudFormation preferred) covering storage, scaling, backups, monitoring, and alerts 
• A concise hand-off document explaining how to deploy and maintain the new setup

You want the existing backend to stay as it is while the data layer gets tighter: indexes and schema changes for faster queries, a possible engine swap if it pays off, and an AWS setup with encrypted storage, automated backups, scaling and CloudWatch alerts, all in infrastructure-as-code. I would start by profiling the slowest endpoints and the current schema, so the index and migration changes are based on real query data. In parallel I would write the Terraform for storage, KMS, backups and monitoring, then refactor the data access code to use the new layer and finish with a hand-off document. description:
أحتاج إلى متخصص إدخال بيانات قادر على تحويل ملفات المصدر التي أزوّدك بها إلى صيغة منظمة وخالية من الأخطاء، مع الالتزام الكامل بالسرعة والدقة في آنٍ واحد. كلما شاركتُك تفاصيل أكثر عن الحقول المطلوبة وطبيعة البيانات سيساعد ذلك في تسليم الخدمة بأقصر وقت ممكن، لذلك سأكون على اتصال مستمر لتوضيح أي جزء أو إرسال نماذج توضيحية عند الحاجة. 

المخرجات المتوقعة هي ملف رقمي منظم وجاهز للاستخدام (سأحدد الصيغة النهائية—سواء Excel، Google Sheets أو نظام إلكتروني—بعد أول تواصل بيننا)، مع مراجعة نهائية تضمن تطابق الحضـور الرقمي مع المعلومات الأصلية حرفياً. سأعتمد على مهارتك في التدقيق، استخدام الاختصارات المناسبة، والتأكد من اتساق التنسيق قبل التسليم النهائي. 

إن كنت مرتاحاً للعمل على مهام تدقيق وتنسيق مكثّفة وتستطيع الالتزام بالمواعيد المتفق عليها، تواصل معي مباشرة لنبدأ العمل.

title: Inspection & BPO Tracking Sheet
description:
Our three-person inspection and BPO crew needs one Google Sheet that keeps every assignment, payment, photo shoot, and profit figure in plain sight.

Workflow 
• A single dispatcher records each new inspection or BPO and assigns it to the proper inspector and photographer. 
• All of us can edit the same sheet to log progress, mark tasks complete, and enter actual income and expenses—so numbers stay current without separate files or emails.

What the sheet must do 
1. House a master table for every job: client, address, assignment & due dates, status drop-down, fee, expected expense, and an automatic profit/loss column. 
2. Offer a linked view for photographer appointments that highlights missing photos. 
3. Track invoices: amount, payment due date, date received, and roll those figures into overall profit/loss. 
4. Trigger automatic alerts: 
 • Upcoming or overdue assignment due dates. 
 • Payments that are due or overdue. 
 • Photographer appointments that are missing photos. 
 Alerts can be color-coded on the sheet and/or emailed via Google Apps Script.

Tech notes 
Everything lives in Google Sheets. If Apps Script is required for alerts or dashboards, include well-commented code so we can tweak it later.

Deliverables 
• Fully built Google Sheet (shared for editing). 
• Attached Apps Script for automated alerts. 
• Quick-start guide showing how to add a job, update status, and adjust alert timing.

Acceptance criteria 
When sample data is entered, the sheet must assign work in under a minute, send/flag the specified alerts, and calculate accurate profit or loss per assignment and in total.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужна общая Google-таблица для трёхчеловечной команды инспекций и BPO: учёт заданий, назначений фотографов, счетов и прибыли/убытков, а также оповещения о сроках, неоплаченных счетах и отсутствующих фото. Оповещения можно выделять цветом и отправлять по email через Google Apps Script.
analysis.reply:
You need one shared Google Sheet covering assignments, photographer appointments, invoices and profit, with alerts for due dates, unpaid invoices and missing photos. I would build a master job table with a status dropdown and automatic profit/loss, a linked photographer view that flags missing photos, and invoice tracking that rolls into totals. Dispatch would be a single-row entry with dropdowns for inspector and photographer, so assignment takes well under a minute. Alerts would use conditional formatting plus a commented Apps Script for email notifications with adjustable timing. Expect a working version with sample data in about 4 days, plus the quick-start guide.

Do you want alert emails going to everyone or only the dispatcher? And should photographer assignments be fixed per inspector or chosen per job?

Live demos are in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужна общая Google-таблица, которая охватывает задания, назначения фотографов, счета и прибыль, с оповещениями о сроках, неоплаченных счетах и отсутствующих фото. Я бы сделал главную таблицу заданий с выпадающим списком статусов и автоматическим расчётом прибыли/убытков, связанное представление для фотографов, которое отмечает отсутствующие фото, и учёт счетов, который суммируется в итоги. Назначение работы делается одной строкой с выпадающими списками инспектора и фотографа, поэтому занимает меньше минуты. Оповещения будут реализованы условным форматированием и откомментированным скриптом Apps Script для email-уведомлений с настраиваемым временем. Рабочая версия с тестовыми данными будет готова примерно за 4 дня, плюс краткое руководство по быстрому старту.

Нужно ли отправлять письма всем или только диспетчеру? И должны ли фотографы закрепляться за инспекторами или выбираться для каждого задания?

Живые демо есть в моём портфолио: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

title: Laravel Bug Fixes & Enhancements
description:
I'm looking for an experienced Laravel developer to review an existing Laravel web application, identify issues and fix bugs to improve its stability and functionality.

Scope of Work:
- Investigate and fix existing Laravel application errors and bugs.
- Resolve issues in controllers, models, routes and database queries.
- Fix frontend issues involving Blade, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
- Troubleshoot API and form submission problems.
- Identify and fix database-related issues.
- Improve application performance where necessary.
- Test the affected features and ensure existing functionality remains intact.

Technical Requirements:
- Strong experience with PHP and Laravel.
- Good knowledge of MySQL.
- Experience with REST APIs, JavaScript and frontend debugging.
- Familiarity with Git and debugging tools.
- Ability to understand and work with an existing codebase.

Deliverables:
- All agreed bugs fixed.
- Tested and working application.
- Updated source code.
- Brief summary of changes made.

Additional Information:
Git access and application details will be provided to the selected freelancer. Please explain your Laravel experience and your approach to debugging existing applications when submitting your bid.

I'm looking for someone reliable who can communicate clearly and deliver quality work.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент ищет Laravel-разработчика для аудита существующего веб-приложения: нужно найти и исправить баги в контроллерах, моделях, маршрутах, запросах к MySQL, Blade/JS/CSS и API, а также улучшить производительность без поломки текущего функционала. Бюджет низкий (1500 INR), но задача понятная и подходящая.
analysis.reply:
From your brief, you need an existing Laravel app reviewed and its bugs fixed across controllers, models, routes, database queries, Blade/JS front-end, and API/form submissions, without breaking what already works. My approach: get Git access, reproduce each reported issue, fix them in small, clearly described commits, then test the affected features before handing the code back with a summary of changes. I'd start with a quick audit to confirm the list of issues and scope against the budget. For a clearly defined list of bugs, I can start right away and give you a timeline once I've reviewed the codebase. Two questions: roughly how many bugs are on your list, and is there a staging environment I can test against? You can see my work with live demos at https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Судя по описанию, нужно проверить существующее Laravel-приложение и исправить баги в контроллерах, моделях, маршрутах, запросах к базе данных, Blade/JS на фронтенде и в отправке форм и API, не сломав уже работающий функционал. Мой подход: получить доступ к Git, воспроизвести каждую проблему, исправить их небольшими понятными коммитами, затем протестировать затронутые функции и передать код вместе с описанием изменений. Я бы начал с быстрого аудита, чтобы подтвердить список проблем и объём работ относительно бюджета. Для чётко описанного списка багов могу начать сразу и назвать сроки после изучения кодовой базы. Два вопроса: примерно сколько багов в списке и есть ли staging-окружение, на котором можно тестировать? Посмотреть мои работы с живыми демо можно здесь: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: Real-Estate Appointment Setter Calls

title: Magento – Cursor / AI-Assisted Developer Required
description:
# Urgent Magento 2 Rebuild – Ecommerce Recovery, Odoo Integration & AI-Assisted Development

We are seeking an experienced Magento developer to urgently rebuild our established Australian ecommerce business on the latest stable version of Magento 2.

Our existing on-premises server suffered a cybersecurity incident resulting in the deletion of virtual hard disks. We have decided to establish a completely fresh, secure environment on hosted infrastructure rather than restore our obsolete production environment.

**We have already recovered and recompiled a product database from alternative data sources.** This database will be made available to the successful developer as the foundation for the new Magento 2 installation. We require assistance with validating, mapping and importing this data, rather than reconstructing the entire database from scratch.

**Mandatory: You must actively use AI development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or equivalent.** These tools must be used for code analysis, development, data transformation, debugging, testing and documentation. Traditional development without AI coding tools is not of interest, and we expect project costs and timeframes to reflect the productivity improvements available through these tools.

## 1. Previous Environment

Our previous production environment consisted of:

- Magento Community 1.9 with customisations and extensions.
- Odoo 10 Community – Python/PostgreSQL ERP.
- Webkul Magento–Odoo Bridge.
- eBay → Odoo → Magento product workflow.
- Microsoft 365 email.
- Zebra printers with custom barcode and label printing functionality.
- eBay and Amazon sales channels.
- Google Shopping integration through Magento.
- Australian and international ecommerce checkout.
- On-premises Hyper-V infrastructure running Debian 9.

We do not intend to recreate the obsolete operating system or legacy infrastructure.

## 2. Recovered Product Database

We have already recovered and recompiled a product database using surviving data and alternative sources.

The developer will be provided with this database for analysis, validation and import into Magento 2.

The required work includes:

- Audit the recovered product database.
- Map existing data to Magento 2 product attributes.
- Resolve duplicate SKUs and inconsistent records.
- Import product titles, descriptions and images.
- Reconstruct categories and configurable products where required.
- Validate pricing and inventory information.
- Preserve supplier references.
- Preserve existing SEO URLs and metadata wherever available.
- Develop repeatable import scripts for future product updates.
- Identify and resolve any missing or incomplete product information.

Additional product information can be sourced from:

- Existing eBay listings.
- Amazon product listings.
- Supplier databases and product feeds.
- Google Merchant Center.
- Previously exported product data.
We will assist with recovery

We do not require historical customer and order databases to be reconstructed as part of this project.

## 3. Immediate Priority – Restore Ecommerce Operations

Our immediate objective is to establish a functional, secure ecommerce website as quickly as reasonably possible.

The availability of a recompiled product database should substantially reduce the initial development and data migration workload.

The project should be divided into phases so that business operations can resume without waiting for every historical customisation and integration to be completed.

### Phase 1 – Minimum Viable Production Website

- Provision secure hosted infrastructure.
- Install and configure the latest stable Magento 2 release.
- Establish staging and production environments.
- Validate and import the recovered product database.
- Configure a suitable responsive theme.
- Configure payment processing.
- Configure shipping and checkout.
- Configure Australian GST and international sales.
- Configure Microsoft 365 transactional email.
- Configure Cloudflare.
- Implement automated offsite backups.
- Test and launch the website.

### Phase 2 – Product Catalogue Refinement

- Resolve outstanding product data issues.
- Complete any missing product information.
- Refine categories and configurable products.
- Validate product images, pricing and inventory.
- Establish repeatable product import and update processes.
- Preserve historical SEO URLs and implement redirects wherever possible.
- Establish Google Shopping integration.

### Phase 3 – Customisations and Integrations

Recreate essential business functionality without unnecessarily reproducing legacy code or obsolete architecture.

Particularly important is our **Zebra barcode and label printing functionality**, which must work with our existing hardware and business workflows.

Where modern extensions or simpler solutions exist, we prefer these over recreating historical custom modules.

## 4. Odoo and Inventory Management

Our previous Odoo usage was relatively simple:

- Import products from eBay into Odoo.
- Export products from Odoo to Magento.
- Maintain product and inventory reference information.

We do not use Odoo for accounting, order processing or fulfilment.

Our previous Magento stock synchronisation was non-functional, and we do not want to recreate an unnecessarily complicated integration.

We are open to:

- Installing a current supported version of Odoo Community.
- Replacing the Webkul connector.
- Developing a lightweight API-based integration.
- Using Magento as the central product database.
- Replacing Odoo entirely if a simpler, more reliable solution meets our requirements.

The developer should recommend the most cost-effective architecture based on our actual operational requirements rather than automatically recreating the previous system.

## 5. Other Integrations

- Microsoft 365 transactional email.
- Payment gateway integration, with the final provider to be confirmed.
- Australian and international shipping.
- Australian GST.
- eBay and Amazon product management.
- Google Shopping.
- API access for Claude and GrokBot automation.
- Future AI-assisted product management and business automation.

We want the new architecture to support automated business processes and AI agents without requiring extensive manual intervention.

## 6. Infrastructure and Cybersecurity

Following the recent cybersecurity incident, security and recoverability are mandatory requirements.

The new environment must include:

- Modern, supported Linux operating system.
- Secure hosted infrastructure.
- Separate staging and production environments.
- SSH key-based authentication.
- Restricted administrative access.
- Multifactor authentication where supported.
- Firewall configuration and server hardening.
- Cloudflare integration.
- Secure API credential management.
- Automated security updates where appropriate.
- Application and server logging.
- Monitoring and security alerts.
- Automated database and application backups.
- Independent offsite backups with version retention and protection against unauthorised deletion.
- Documented and tested disaster recovery procedures.

Recovered data must be validated before being

analysis.summary_ru: Восстановление интернет-магазина на Magento 2 на новом хостинге: аудит и импорт восстановленной базы товаров, затем интеграции с Odoo, eBay и Amazon по фазам. Требуется обязательное использование ИИ-инструментов разработки. Бюджет 750 AUD, при этом объём работ большой.
analysis.reply:
You need a Magento 2 store rebuilt on fresh hosting, with the recovered product catalogue audited, mapped and imported, and the Odoo, eBay and Amazon links restored in later phases. I'd start with the data: check the recovered set, resolve duplicate SKUs and gaps, and write repeatable import scripts so the catalogue can be reloaded and updated without manual rework. I use AI coding assistants daily for analysis, scripting and testing, which matches your requirement. For Phase 1 (hosting, Magento install, import, theme, checkout and GST setup) I'd estimate 3–4 weeks, and I'd confirm that after reviewing a sample of the data. Two questions: what format is the recovered product database in (CSV, SQL dump), and roughly how many SKUs does it contain? Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужно пересобрать магазин на Magento 2 на новом хостинге: провести аудит восстановленной базы товаров, сопоставить данные, импортировать их, а интеграции с Odoo, eBay и Amazon вернуть на следующих этапах. Я бы начал с данных: проверил бы восстановленный набор, устранил дубли SKU и пробелы, и написал бы повторяемые скрипты импорта, чтобы каталог можно было перезагружать и обновлять без ручной работы. Я ежедневно использую ИИ-ассистенты для разработки: анализа, скриптов и тестирования, это соответствует вашему требованию. Для первого этапа (хостинг, установка Magento, импорт, тема, оформление заказа и настройка GST) оцениваю срок в 3–4 недели, точнее подтвержу после просмотра образца данных. Два вопроса: в каком формате восстановленная база товаров (CSV, SQL-дамп) и примерно сколько в ней SKU? Портфолио с живыми демо: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
questions: В каком формате находится восстановленная база товаров (CSV, SQL-дамп, другое)?
Примерно сколько SKU в базе и насколько много в ней дублей и неполных записей?

description:

title: Interactive Webcomic Website Build
description:
I have an ongoing webcomic and I’m ready to give it a dedicated home. The site must display one comic page at a time but still let readers switch to a full-chapter scroll when they prefer. An archive section should list every chapter with its individual pages so visitors can jump straight to any point in the story.

Beyond the comic itself, I keep a growing trove of lore. Readers need a separate “Worldbuilding” area where they can search or filter entries by topic—characters, locations, timelines, you name it—without wading through the main archive.

For engagement, each comic page should allow comments or quick emoji-style reactions. New pages will go live automatically on a schedule I set in the backend, so a reliable scheduler tied to the site clock (or a CMS cron) is essential.

Key deliverables
• A responsive website (desktop + mobile) that loads one comic page by default with next/previous navigation and an option to view the whole chapter in a continuous scroll 
• Chapter/page archive that is easy to browse and deep-linkable 
• Worldbuilding section with search and filter functionality 
• Comment/reaction system tied to individual pages 
• Admin panel where I can bulk-upload pages, set publish dates, reorder chapters, and manage lore entries 
• Automated scheduler to push pages live at the specified times 
• Clean, documented code (CMS or custom stack—open to WordPress + plugin, static-site generator, or a lightweight framework if it meets the brief)

I’ll provide the artwork, chapter order, and initial worldbuilding data; you handle design, development, basic SEO, and deploying to my hosting. Let me know the tools or frameworks you’d prefer and any past comic or image-driven sites you’ve built so I can see how you approach flow and performance.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен сайт для веб-комикса с постраничным просмотром и режимом прокрутки всей главы, архивом с прямыми ссылками, разделом лора с поиском и фильтрами, комментариями или реакциями к страницам, админ-панелью и планировщиком публикации. Бюджет 250 EUR для такого объёма довольно скромный.
analysis.reply:
You want a comic reader that shows one page by default but can switch to a full-chapter scroll, with a deep-linkable archive, a searchable worldbuilding section, per-page reactions, and timed releases from an admin panel. I'd build it on a fast static stack (Astro or Eleventy) so pages load quickly on mobile, with a lightweight admin for bulk uploads, publish dates, and chapter ordering. Timed releases would run through a scheduled rebuild or your CMS cron. Reactions can use a small hosted backend tied to each page URL. For the first release I'd estimate about two weeks for the reader, archive, and scheduler, with worldbuilding search and comments after that. Would you rather use a headless CMS you already have, or a custom admin? And roughly how many pages per chapter will you launch with?

See my live demos in the portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: Dual-Temperature Thermal Reference Prototype -- 2
description:
**Development of a Dual Temperature Reference Device for Thermal Imaging Research**

I am a biomedical engineering professor at a Brazilian university looking for an electronics engineer to develop a complete experimental prototype for a non-commercial academic research project.

The device will provide two stable temperature references within the field of view of a thermal imaging camera used for continuous monitoring in an intensive care unit (ICU).

**1. Thermal and mechanical design**

- Two square metal plates, each measuring 250 × 250 mm, preferably made of aluminum.
- High-emissivity matte black surface coating to approximate blackbody radiation.
- Independent temperature control at 35°C and 42°C, respectively.
- Uniform temperature distribution across each plate.
- Suitable heating elements installed behind the plates.
- Rear thermal insulation to minimize heat loss.
- Mechanical support and a custom 3D-printed enclosure for the electronic components.

**2. Temperature measurement and control**

- Four-wire PT100 RTD temperature sensors, preferably Class A or better.
- MAX31865 temperature acquisition circuits or equivalent.
- Independent closed-loop temperature control for each plate.
- ESP32 or equivalent microcontroller.
- Custom PCB integrating temperature acquisition, heating control, communication and protection circuits.
- The desired temperature stability is ±0.1°C, subject to technical feasibility and experimental verification.

**3. Power supply and safety**

- Reliable, commercially available and appropriately certified power supply from a reputable manufacturer.
- Preferably low-voltage DC heating elements.
- Independent hardware-based overheating protection.
- Automatic heater shutdown in case of sensor failure, controller failure or excessive temperature.
- Maximum plate surface temperature must remain below 50°C under foreseeable fault conditions.
- Electrical protection, appropriate connectors and reliable continuous operation.

**4. Data logging and communication**

- Continuous acquisition of the actual temperature of both plates.
- Automatic generation of daily CSV files.
- Each record must include date, time, measured temperatures, temperature setpoints and system status.
- Configurable sampling interval, initially one sample per second.
- Wi-Fi communication with a central monitoring computer.
- Automatic recovery after power interruptions.
- Designed for continuous 24/7 operation over several months.

**5. Expected deliverables**

- One fully assembled and tested functional prototype.
- Complete electronic schematics.
- Editable PCB design files and Gerber files.
- Complete firmware and software source code.
- Editable mechanical design files and STL files for 3D printing.
- Bill of materials with component specifications and purchase links.
- Assembly and operating instructions.
- Experimental report demonstrating temperature accuracy, temporal stability, spatial uniformity and continuous operation.

This is a single-unit academic research prototype with no commercial purpose. Cost-effective engineering solutions are preferred.

Please provide a proposed technical solution, estimated development time and separate quotations for engineering services, electronic components, PCB manufacturing, mechanical parts, assembly, testing and international shipping to Brazil.

Final metrological validation and authorization for installation in the clinical environment will be conducted separately by our research team.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик, профессор из Бразилии, ищет инженера-электроника для создания одного экспериментального прототипа устройства с двумя термоэталонными пластинами (35°C и 42°C) для калибровки тепловизоров в исследовательских целях. Основная часть работы — электроника, разводка печатной платы, механика, сборка и тестирование, а не разработка ПО.

title: Enterprise IT Home Lab Setup
description:
Enterprise IT & Network Home Lab Setup + Hands-On Training
Hiring: Senior IT Infrastructure / Network Engineer
Project type: Fixed price • Remote • Milestone-based
Budget: Open to reasonable offers, with separate pricing for each milestone.
1. Project overview
I am looking for an experienced infrastructure engineer to design and build a realistic virtual enterprise IT lab on my personal workstation. The lab should represent a medium-sized company with approximately 250 simulated employees, multiple departments and three interconnected locations.
My objective is to independently install, configure, administer, secure and troubleshoot enterprise systems and networks. This is a joint implementation and training project, not simply a request for a preconfigured lab.
2. Available hardware and platform
• Dell Precision T5500, 64 GB RAM, HD storage 2 TB
• Windows 11 Pro; VMware Workstation 16.2.5
Assess CPU, storage, hypervisor compatibility and available resources before implementation. VMware is preferred; Proxmox or other suitable software may be proposed with justification. Do not replace the host operating system without approval. Use modular VM groups, snapshots and documented startup/shutdown procedures so only required systems run at once.
3. Enterprise architecture
• Headquarters (Hannover): central servers, Active Directory, firewall, routing and departmental VLANs.
• Branch 1 (Berlin): local clients, router/firewall, VLANs and site-to-site VPN to headquarters.
• Branch 2 (Hamburg): independent branch network, VLANs, clients and VPN connectivity.
Use isolated virtual WAN and LAN networks, with controlled internet access. Keep the lab separate from personal and employer production networks and accounts.

4. Technical scope
Enterprise networking and security
• Virtual routers and managed switches; access ports, 802.1Q trunks, VLANs and inter-VLAN routing.
• IPv4 subnetting, static routing, OSPF, WAN/ISP simulation, NAT, DHCP relay and ACLs.
• OPNsense, pfSense or equivalent firewalls; network segmentation, DMZ and firewall rules.
• Site-to-site IPsec VPN and remote-access WireGuard or OpenVPN; VPN troubleshooting.
• Forward and reverse proxy, network monitoring and Wireshark packet analysis.
Use GNS3, Cisco Packet Tracer or another suitable platform where VMware alone cannot provide the required functionality. Explain which components interoperate with the live VMs and which are separate simulations. Use legally obtained appliance images and licenses.
Enterprise wireless networking
• Corporate and guest SSIDs, VLAN mapping, RADIUS using Windows NPS or FreeRADIUS, and WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise concepts.
• Centralized access point management, capacity planning for 100+ wireless clients, access policies and authentication troubleshooting.
Physical access points are not mandatory. Simulate what is technically possible and explain limitations, including RF coverage, roaming and channel planning.
Windows Server and Active Directory
• Windows Server 2022/2025, primary and secondary domain controllers, replication, DNS and DHCP.
• OUs, approximately 250 simulated users, groups, delegated administration, GPOs and Windows 11 domain clients.
• SMB file shares, NTFS permissions, DFS, print services and patch management.
• Windows LAPS, AD Certificate Services (PKI), NPS/RADIUS, server hardening and recovery.
Microsoft cloud and hybrid identity
Where test tenants and licenses permit: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, hybrid synchronization, Intune, Autopilot, compliance, Conditional Access, Defender endpoint security and PowerShell. Identify paid features and use only a dedicated test tenant.
Linux, monitoring, backup and automation
Ubuntu Server, SSH, Nginx or equivalent web services, forward/reverse proxy, Zabbix or PRTG, centralized logging, certificate management, backup and tested restore, PowerShell and optional Ansible.

5. Mandatory hybrid implementation and training
The freelancer must explain the infrastructure through live screen-sharing sessions and actively involve me in configuration. I must be able to reproduce the work independently.
Phase A — Freelancer builds and explains
Set up virtualization, virtual networking, headquarters firewall, routing, VLANs and the first branch VPN. Demonstrate and explain each major configuration, including how traffic flows and how to verify it.
Phase B — We configure together
Guide me while I personally configure additional VLANs, routing rules, the second branch VPN, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, GPOs, file permissions, firewall policies, monitoring and backup. I perform the configuration with your supervision.
Phase C — Independent practical exercises
Provide an additional branch scenario for me to configure independently, including VLANs, routing and VPN. Assign tasks involving domain users, groups, GPOs, DNS, DHCP, firewall rules and service recovery. Review my work and explain mistakes.
Phase D — Advanced troubleshooting
Provide at least 10 practical exercises with separate solutions, including deliberately simulated incidents: AD authentication failures, DNS and DHCP issues, broken VPN tunnels, incorrect VLAN routing, firewall misconfiguration, GPO conflicts, file permissions, server outages, monitoring alerts and recovery.
6. Required deliverables
• Working, reusable modular lab with network topology diagram, IP addressing and VLAN plan.
• VM inventory including CPU, RAM, storage and network interfaces; firewall, routing and VPN configuration files.
• Step-by-step installation and configuration guides; startup, shutdown, reset and rebuild instructions.
• At least 10 exercises with separate solutions, live training and final independent practical assessment.
• Backup and restore procedures, demonstrated recovery and secure handover of credentials and configuration files.
All remote access must be authorized and supervised. Remove temporary freelancer access after handover. The lab must remain usable without ongoing dependency on the freelancer.

7. Milestones and acceptance
1 — Design
Hardware assessment, architecture, network diagram, VM sizing and virtualization setup.
2 — Core network
Headquarters VLANs, firewall, WAN and first VPN; demonstrate allowed and blocked traffic.
3 — Branch networking
Additional branch, routing, switching, VPN and wireless/RADIUS training; verify connectivity and segmentation.
4 — Enterprise systems
Windows Server, AD, DNS, DHCP, GPO, file services and client administration; demonstrate domain login and permissions.
5 — Advanced services
Security, proxy, monitoring, backup, cloud integration where feasible; demonstrate alerting and recovery.
6 — Handover
Documentation, exercises, final testing and knowledge transfer; demonstrate independent configuration and troubleshooting.
Payment should be linked to successfully completed and demonstrated milestones. Quote optional modules separately so the project can be expanded within my budget.
8. Required qualifications
Professional experience in enterprise infrastructure, Windows Server/AD, VMware or Proxmox, Cisco-style networking, VLANs, WANs, routing, firewalls, IPsec VPN, Microsoft 365/Entra/Intune, monitoring, security and technical training. Experience with German enterprise IT environments and German technical terminology is an advantage.
9. Proposal requirements
• Relevant experience and examples of similar projects.
• Proposed architecture, software, VM count, CPU/RAM/storage requirements and necessary upgrades.
• Clear distinction between live functionality and simulation; software licensing and recurring costs.
• Implementation timeline, number and duration of live training sessions, fixed-price milestone quotation.
• Explain how you will ensure I can independently configure, administer and troubleshoot the lab.
Expected result: a realistic enterprise learning environment for IT System Administrator.

title: AI Telegram FAQ Support Bot
description:
I want to launch a Telegram-based chatbot that can automatically answer the most common product and service questions my customers ask. All of the information it serves should be pulled in real time from the existing pages on my website so I never have to maintain a separate knowledge base.

Here is how I expect it to behave:
• When a user types a question, the bot scans the relevant pages, extracts the answer, and replies instantly inside Telegram. 
• If it cannot locate a clear, confident match, it politely advises the user to contact our support team for further help. No hallucinations or guesses—accuracy is key. 

Please build, test, and connect the bot to my Telegram account, set up any required web-scraping or embedding pipeline so page updates are reflected automatically, and provide brief hand-over instructions so I can manage basic tweaks myself later.

analysis.reply:

Retrieval would find the matching passage and return only text taken from the page, with a confidence threshold that triggers the 'contact support' reply instead of guessing. I'd connect it to your Telegram account, test it against a sample set of questions, and leave short hand-over notes for future tweaks. Estimated timeline: about 1–2 weeks, depending on site size. Two questions: roughly how many pages need indexing, and do you prefer an LLM-based answer generator or a strictly extractive approach?

title: Flask-React Mobile App Redesign
description:

All core logic is stable, so the job is almost entirely UI/UX—think new layouts, updated colour palette, cleaner typography, and smarter routing without disrupting existing endpoints.

You’ll work in my current repo (Flask + React, GitHub) and deliver fully responsive components, updated style sheets, and any minor adjustments needed on the Flask side to serve revised assets. I’ll handle deployment; I just need pull-request–ready code and a concise changelog.

When you apply, link to past redesign or front-end upgrade work you’ve done with React (mobile-friendly projects preferred). No lengthy proposals—just show me before-and-after examples or a live link and a brief note on the stack you used. 

Key deliverables 
• New React components for all primary screens 
• Re-architected navigation flow (React Router) 
• Polished, consistent styling (CSS-in-JS or SASS—your choice)

Code quality, accessibility, and performance are non-negotiable; Lighthouse scores should remain the same or improve. Let’s give my users a smoother ride.

title: Editable Touchscreen Prize Wheel
description:
At our next live event I want guests to walk up to a large touchscreen, tap once, and watch a colourful wheel spin toward a random prize. The experience needs to feel slick and self-contained: no internet connection, just a browser running full-screen in kiosk mode (Chrome or Edge is fine).

Here’s the flow I have in mind. A visitor taps the screen, the wheel animates with realistic easing, then slows to a stop. The winning segment triggers an on-screen message such as “Congratulations! You’ve won a water bottle.” After a short timeout the wheel resets itself so the next person can play immediately.

I need to be able to adjust everything myself between show days—prize names, segment colours, odds, background image, even the centre logo—without digging into code. A simple JSON, CSV, or small admin panel works as long as it’s clearly documented. Please package the complete, editable source (HTML5 / JavaScript or any lightweight framework that stays browser-only) together with concise setup instructions so my team can load it onto any Windows laptop or touchscreen display and go live.

Deliverables 
• Fully editable spin-the-wheel application that runs offline in a modern browser 
• Configuration method for prizes, probabilities, colours, and branding assets 
• On-screen prize message display with automatic reset 
• Clear deployment & editing guide (brief PDF or README)

I’ll test by loading it on a 1080p touchscreen; smooth animation and easy prize edits will be the acceptance criteria.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужно офлайн-приложение «колесо призов» для сенсорного экрана на мероприятии: одно касание запускает вращение, а призы, шансы, цвета и логотип редактируются без программирования. После выигрыша показывается сообщение, затем колесо автоматически сбрасывается.
analysis.reply:
You want a self-contained, offline spin wheel that guests trigger with one tap on a 1080p touchscreen, with prizes, odds, colours and logo editable through a plain config file and an automatic reset after each win. I would build it as a single HTML5 Canvas app in vanilla JavaScript, with weighted random selection, an eased spin animation, and a config.json for prizes, weights, colours and image assets. I would also write a short README covering setup in kiosk-mode Chrome or Edge. Timeline: about 3 to 4 days for the core app, plus a day for testing on a 1080p display and writing the guide. Two questions: do you need results logged or exported, and will the logo and background be supplied as image files?

You can see live demos of my work at https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужно автономное колесо призов, которое гости запускают одним касанием сенсорного экрана 1080p. Призы, шансы, цвета и логотип должны редактироваться через простой файл конфигурации, а после каждого выигрыша колесо должно сбрасываться автоматически. Я бы сделал одно HTML5-приложение на Canvas и чистом JavaScript: взвешенный случайный выбор, плавную анимацию вращения и config.json для призов, весов, цветов и изображений. Также написал бы короткую инструкцию по запуску в Chrome или Edge в режиме киоска. Срок: примерно 3–4 дня на основную версию и ещё день на тестирование на экране 1080p и написание инструкции. title: Customer Account Support Specialist Needed
description:
I’m the HR manager at Algility and I need a proactive customer account support specialist who can become the first point of contact for our users over email and live chat. Your primary focus will be keeping every account accurate, accessible, and problem-free, while delivering clear, friendly answers that reflect our brand voice.

Day-to-day you’ll:
• Respond to customer questions, clarifying product features and guiding best-practice use. 
• Set up new accounts, update existing profiles, and ensure data consistency in our CRM. 
• Troubleshoot login, access, or billing issues, coordinating with our engineering and finance teams when deeper fixes are required.

A background in SaaS support, familiarity with common help-desk tools (Zendesk, Intercom, or similar), and strong written English are important. Experience with device management or AI project workflows is a plus; if you’ve handled those before, let me know, as we have parallel initiatives in the pipeline where that knowledge could shine.

Success will be measured by response speed, resolution rate, and user satisfaction scores. If you’re ready to help our customers feel supported from the very first interaction, I’d love to hear how you can make an impact at Algility.

analysis.summary_ru: HR-менеджер Algility ищет специалиста поддержки клиентов для ответов по email и в live chat, ведения аккаунтов в CRM и работы с help-desk инструментами. Это постоянная операционная роль, а не проект разработки.
questions: Это постоянная должность в штате или ко-работа на аутсорсе?
Нужна ли разработка или интеграция с их CRM, или задача только в операционной поддержке?

title: Graphic Designer & WordPress Developer Needed.
description:
We are seeking an experienced freelance graphic designer and WordPress developer to support the initial digital launch of an emerging premium Indian home décor and lifestyle brand.

We are looking to establish a professional brand presence through a company profile and supplier partnership brochure, alongside an introductory WordPress website.

We are interested in building a long-term working relationship, with opportunities for further assignments as the business develops.

Initial Project Requirements

1. Company Profile & Supplier Partnership Brochure (10–12 Pages)

Design a professionally presented brochure covering:

Brand introduction, story and business overview.

Product categories and curated collections, with relevant visuals and descriptions.

Sourcing approach and supplier collaboration model.

Explanation of our supplier-led fulfilment partnership and how we work with suppliers.

The brochure should communicate the brand, business model and partnership opportunity, rather than function solely as a product catalogue.

Required formats: print-ready PDF, web-optimised PDF and editable source files.

2. WordPress Website Development

Develop and refine our existing WordPress website using our current domain and hosting.

The website should include six main sections:

Home

Our Story

Collections (12 product categories)

Supplier Partnerships

Supplier Enquiry Form

Contact

Requirements include responsive design, WordPress/Elementor development, basic SEO and performance optimisation.

E-commerce and payment gateway integration are not required at this stage.

Preferred Skills

Canva or Adobe InDesign.

WordPress and Elementor.

Company profiles, brochures and product catalogue design.

Strong visual design, typography and branding.

Responsive website development and basic SEO.

Experience with lifestyle, home décor or premium consumer brands.

Project Arrangement

This is an initial, fixed-price paid assignment, divided into two deliverables: the brochure and the website.

The project will be developed in stages, with agreed deliverables, revisions, timelines and milestone-based payments.

There is potential for further collaboration involving social media management, product photography, content creation, website enhancements and digital marketing as the business grows.

We prefer freelancers based in India who can coordinate during regular Indian Standard Time business hours.

Please Include in Your Proposal

Portfolio and previous website links.

Examples of company profiles, brochures or catalogues designed by you.

Confirmation of whether you work independently or with a team.

Separate fixed-price quotations for the brochure and website.

Estimated delivery timelines and number of revisions included.

Any additional costs, including image licensing, premium themes or plugins.

We look forward to connecting with creative professionals interested in collaborating on an emerging brand.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент ищет фрилансера для двух задач: дизайн корпоративной брошюры для поставщиков (10–12 страниц) и доработка существующего WordPress-сайта на Elementor (6 разделов, адаптивность, базовое SEO, форма для поставщиков). Бюджет небольшой, а брошюра относится к дизайну, которым Яков не занимается, поэтому интерес только к части с сайтом.
analysis.reply:

I would take the website part only. I'd start with a quick audit of the current setup, then rebuild the pages in Elementor on a clean theme, set up the enquiry form with email notifications, and optimise speed and basic SEO (titles, meta descriptions, image compression). For this scope I'd estimate 7–10 days, including two rounds of revisions. I don't do brochure design, so that would need a separate designer.

You can see live demos here: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Are the brochure content and images ready, or should the site use placeholders for now? Which theme and Elementor version are currently installed?

title: WooCommerce Setup with Razorpay & SMTP
description:
Project Title

WordPress Theme Installation + Razorpay Payment & SMTP Setup for HYDR

Project Description

We already have a WordPress/WooCommerce website hosted on Hostinger. We need a freelancer to complete the following setup.

Scope of Work

1. Theme Installation

* Install a suitable free WooCommerce theme.
* Import a ready-made demo template.
* Apply HYDR’s blue-and-white branding.
* Add our logo and product images.
* Configure the basic homepage.
* Ensure mobile responsiveness.

2. Razorpay Payment Integration

* Install and configure the official Razorpay WooCommerce plugin.
* Connect our Razorpay business account.
* Configure online payment methods.
* Test the payment process.

3. SMTP Email Configuration

* Configure SMTP for our domain email.
* Set up reliable order confirmation emails.
* Configure customer order notifications.
* Test email delivery.

4. Final Testing

* Test Add to Cart and Checkout.
* Test Razorpay payment integration.
* Test order confirmation emails.
* Ensure existing products, customers and orders are preserved.

Important

* Website is already built.
* No development from scratch.
* No expensive paid themes or plugins without our approval.
* We will provide the necessary account access.
* All work must be completed on our existing Hostinger website.

Fixed Budget: ₹1,000

Please share your previous WordPress/WooCommerce experience and estimated completion time.

Бюджет небольшой (1500 INR), срок не указан.

You need the existing WooCommerce store on Hostinger set up with a free theme in HYDR's blue-and-white branding, the official Razorpay plugin connected, and SMTP order emails working, while keeping the current products, customers and orders intact. I can take on the integration and email side: installing and branding the theme, configuring the plugin, and running test orders from add-to-cart through to the confirmation email. My work is mostly custom code and API integrations, so I would be careful with the WooCommerce parts and back up the site before changing anything. Rough estimate: 2–3 days once I have access. Could you tell me whether the domain mailbox for SMTP already exists, and whether you will share Hostinger admin access or prefer to do the steps together? You can also see my live demos here: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: Email Server Logs Analysis
description:
Email Server Logs Analysis 

Expert Witness / Technical Assessment Brief: Protocol-Level Email Logs, Public DNS MX Records, and Custom Anti-Malware DOM Inspection Under CMA 1990 

Dear Consultant, 

I am seeking an independent, court-ready technical expert report for ongoing UK Employment Tribunal proceedings. 

The opposing party has initiated disciplinary proceedings alleging that standard network log capture, querying public DNS Mail Exchanger (MX) records, sending an email via a custom SMTP client with verbose protocol logging, and running a custom anti-phishing/anti-malware script to inspect login page Document Object Models (DOM) constitute unauthorized "probing" or misuse of their infrastructure under Section 1 of the Computer Misuse Act 1990 (CMA 1990). 

1. Scope of Technical Review 
To keep the review focused and cost-effective, no source code is provided. Instead, I require an objective forensic assessment based strictly on short transaction logs, public DNS outputs, tool descriptions, and protocol behavior: 

- Protocol-Level Email Client Logs: Evaluating short SMTP transaction transcripts (approx. 20 lines) recording a standard RFC 5321 email delivery to a public-facing corporate mail exchanger gateway on TCP port 25, including an earlier transmission directed to a standard test endpoint meant for non-communication purposes to ensure no active human mailboxes were impacted. 

- Public DNS MX Record & Policy Lookups: Evaluating standard DNS lookups retrieving public Mail Exchanger (MX) records and publicly hosted MTA-STS policy files. 

- Custom Anti-Malware / Anti-Phishing Software: Evaluating a local utility that runs a headless browser instance to inspect the Document Object Model (DOM) of a public login page (e.g., verifying form action URLs and checking if password fields properly enforce autocomplete attributes to protect against credential scraping and phishing). 

2. Materials Provided for Inspection 
Upon engagement, I will provide: 

- Short raw session transcripts / log files (approx. 20 lines each). 

- Public DNS MX and MTA-STS policy query outputs. 

- Functional descriptions of the custom email client (with protocol-level logging) and the custom anti-phishing DOM inspection tool. 

- The opposing party's internal IT assessment alleging "active probing" and unauthorized DNS analysis. 

3. Specific Questions for Your Expert Report 
Please address the following four questions in your report: 

1. Protocol Logging & Delivery: Do the provided short SMTP transaction logs demonstrate standard, RFC-compliant client-server interactions (EHLO, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA, QUIT) rather than vulnerability scanning, exploitation, or intrusion? 

2. Assessment of Custom Email Software: Does the use of a custom email client configured to record verbose socket-level protocol interaction logs constitute unauthorized probing or a malicious act under Section 1 of the Computer Misuse Act 1990? 

3. Assessment of Public DNS MX Record Analysis: Does querying and analyzing public DNS Mail Exchanger (MX) records and MTA-STS policy files constitute an unauthorized intrusion, probing, or violation under Section 1 of the Computer Misuse Act 1990, or are such records inherently public-facing data intended for universal administrative and mail-routing inspection? 

4. Assessment of Custom Anti-Malware Software: Does the use of a local anti-malware/anti-phishing utility that evaluates public web page DOM elements (such as password field autocomplete attributes and form action endpoints) constitute probing, testing, or unauthorized access to the web server that served the page? 

4. Format & Tribunal Standards 
Please confirm that you can prepare this report in compliance with UK Employment Tribunal expert evidence standards (stating your relevant industry accreditations, qualifications, and understanding that your overriding duty is to assist the Tribunal objectively). 

Please let me know your availability, fee structure, and estimated turnaround time.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик ищет независимого технического эксперта для подготовки экспертного заключения в трудовом споре в Великобритании. Нужен анализ SMTP-логов, DNS MX-записей и инструмента проверки DOM страницы входа на соответствие Computer Misuse Act 1990. Это экспертиза, а не разработка.

title: Migración Chatwoot WhatsApp Cloud API

• Configura los inboxes, webhooks y tokens necesarios. 
• Desvincula Hibot sin cortes: podemos mover un número a la vez para reducir riesgos y mantener el servicio activo. 

Acepto trabajar por hitos siempre que garanticen: 
1. Números operativos en Chatwoot con plantillas íntegras. 
2. Contactos e historial visibles y consultables. 
3. Notificaciones en tiempo real vía webhooks. 
4. Cierre ordenado de la cuenta en Hibot. 

Cuéntame en tu propuesta: 
• Proyectos donde ya integraste Chatwoot con la API oficial de WhatsApp, especialmente si manejaste más de un número o varias WABA. 
• Tu proceso concreto para conservar plantillas, números y datos al cambiar de proveedor. 
• Tiempo estimado de entrega total y coste. 

Todo el trabajo y documentación deben entregarse en español.

Para contactos e historial evaluaré qué formatos exporta Hibot. Calculo unas 2–3 semanas para la primera fase con tres agentes, y el coste lo ajustamos cuando tengamos claro el estado de las WABA.

¿Los dos números están en la misma cuenta de Meta Business o en portafolios distintos? ¿Puedes exportar desde Hibot el historial y los contactos?

Puedes ver demos en vivo en https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Понимаю, что тебе нужно перенести поддержку двух номеров WhatsApp Cloud API из Hibot в Chatwoot, всё на испанском, без потери одобренных шаблонов и самих номеров, и отключить Hibot поэтапно, чтобы не прерывать сервис. Мой подход: сначала развернуть Chatwoot на простом управляемом сервисе, затем проверить, в каком WABA находится каждый номер и в каком состоянии его шаблоны, настроить inboxes, токены и webhooks, после чего переносить по одному номеру, проверяя входящие и исходящие сообщения, прежде чем переходить к следующему. По контактам и истории посмотрю, в каких форматах Hibot их экспортирует. Оцениваю первый этап с тремя агентами примерно в 2–3 недели; стоимость уточним, когда будет ясна картина по WABA.

Демо в реальном времени можно посмотреть здесь: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

title: Lock Down Hacked Devices ASAP
description:
Someone I know has managed to gain remote control over every device I own—my Android phone (currently running GrapheneOS), a Windows laptop, the home router, even linked email and social media accounts—all without ever touching them. I can’t afford another day of exposure. What I need from you is a full-scale lockdown so the intruder is cut off for good.
