title: Build Finance Content and Calculator Platform
description:
Website Build: Educational Finance Platform with Interactive Calculators
The Tax Floor · Content site + registered-user calculator suite · Contract
The project
We are building a marketing and content website for an educational personal-finance project called The Tax Floor. The site will publish a substantial long-form body of writing — roughly the equivalent of a book, plus a set of client-facing reference documents — alongside a suite of five interactive calculators that registered users can run on their own numbers.
It is not a typical brochure site. The content is long, edited often, and carries a legal position that has to hold on every page. The calculators are the functional core and have to reproduce a working prototype exactly before anyone extends them. The build is roughly half content platform and half financial application.
What makes this interesting to build
A long-form educational archive with a real editorial model behind it, a genuinely non-trivial calculator engine with a test suite, a five-stage content funnel with a single deliberate gate, and a compliance surface that is part of the acceptance criteria rather than an afterthought.

What you will deliver
# Deliverable Notes
1 Design system and high-fidelity designs for every page type Content pages, calculator pages, forms, charts
2 Responsive build of the full site Server-rendered content, static-first
3 Calculator engine — five tools with a test suite Rebuilt from a working prototype; see below
4 Content populated from supplied source documents Approximately a book plus supporting reference material
5 Three charts, built from a supplied dataset With accessible text alternatives
6 Three capture surfaces — download form, question form, booking flow Plus a book waitlist
7 Compliance pack — page-by-page evidence of disclaimer placement Part of acceptance
8 Analytics and event instrumentation Eight defined events
9 Documentation and handover A non-developer must be able to publish a chapter and edit a tax figure

Scope of work
Content platform
• A structured content model supporting chapters, case studies, FAQ entries, glossary terms, and calculator definitions.
• Rich content blocks: headings, lists, data tables, callouts, pull quotes, formulas, figures with captions.
• Navigation across a large archive, plus search and in-page anchors.
• One editable value driving every mention of the project’s publication status.
Calculator suite
Five tools, each recomputing on input change with no page reload: a portfolio modelling tool, a bracket-based conversion calculator, a sensitivity tool with sliders, a year-sampling tool, and a twenty-year time-series tool. Requirements:
• A single shared, framework-agnostic calculation library — no tool reimplements the arithmetic.
• Pure functions throughout: inputs to outputs, no side effects, no network calls.
• Validation on every numeric input, with helpful messages. No NaN, Infinity or blank cells, ever.
• Input state persisted in the URL so a scenario can be bookmarked and shared.
• Registered users can save, name and reload scenarios.
• A print stylesheet rendering each tool’s results as a clean page.
• Historic return data loaded from a supplied dataset — no figure may be invented.
Capture and conversion surfaces
• A one-page download form with a single qualifying question.
• A question-submission form with a topic dropdown and required consent language.
• A booking flow: short pre-qualification form, then a calendar slot picker.
• A waitlist capture for a product launching later.
• Conditional email delivery for a three-email sequence.
Compliance requirements (acceptance criteria, not guidance)
This project centres on financial education and sits close to regulated territory. The following are gates: a build that omits them does not pass.
• A full disclaimer appears on every page that shows a figure or a calculator.
• Eight specific content limitations must survive the content port intact and be present or unmissably linked on every figure-bearing page.
• No page may present a not-yet-launched product as available, orderable or shipping.
• No page may read as personalised advice. The booking flow must state explicitly that no advice is given.
• No tracking of calculator inputs, and no advertising pixels on calculator pages.
Suggested stack
Layer Preference Why
Framework Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript Server rendering for a large content archive; client components only for the calculators
Content Headless CMS or MDX in-repo Long-form content edited often, ideally without a deploy
Calculator engine One shared, tested TypeScript library All five tools share arithmetic and must not diverge
Charts Lightweight SVG charting library Accessibility and bundle size
Styling Utility-first CSS with design tokens Consistency across a large surface
Hosting Static-first with edge caching Performance budget

Open to alternatives if you can justify them. Team preference and maintainability matter more than the specific choices above.
Skills we are looking for
Essential Desirable
Strong React and TypeScript Experience with financial calculators or modelling UIs
Server-rendered content architecture at scale Headless CMS integration
Accessibility to WCAG 2.2 AA Data visualisation with accessible alternatives
Test-driven development for calculation logic Compliance-adjacent or regulated-content projects
Responsive, performance-conscious front-end work Email and calendar API integration

How we will work
• One repository, trunk-based development, pull requests reviewed by a named technical contact.
• A staging environment updated on every merge, so content and compliance can be reviewed continuously.
• A defined acceptance regime: unit tests for the engine, integration tests for the tools, cross-browser and device testing, an accessibility audit, a performance audit, and a signed compliance review.
• Weekly written status: what shipped, what is blocked, what was decided.
• Disagreement welcome. If a requirement looks wrong, say so early and in writing.
One thing worth reading before you apply
The acceptance criteria include a requirement that a set of specific content limitations survive the port to the web. This is the requirement most often treated as trimmable copy. It is not — it is the reason the project exists in the form it does, and a build that quietly drops it fails. If that sounds like an interesting constraint rather than an annoying one, you will enjoy this project.

Commercial and logistics
Item Detail
Engagement Contract, quoted per deliverable rather than as a single figure, so scope changes stay visible
Remote Fully remote; occasional calls in US business hours
Duration To be agreed at scoping
Start As soon as the right person is available
Full brief A detailed developer package with page-by-page specifications, acceptance criteria and a QA regime is available on request
Budget Open — quoted per deliverable

How to apply
Send a short note covering:
1. Two or three sites you have built where content scale or calculation logic was the hard part, and what was hard about them.
2. How you would approach the calculator engine — specifically, how you would guarantee that five tools sharing arithmetic do not drift apart.
3. Anything in the scope above you think is wrong, underspecified, or would cost more than we expect.
The third question matters more to us than the first two. We want someone who will push back on the brief, not someone who will build exactly what is written and then explain the problems afterwards.

title: Egyptian Venue Booking Platform
description:
I’m building a central marketplace that lets people across Egypt locate and secure venues for weddings, corporate events, and private gatherings from one intuitive app. Users must be able to filter spaces by event type, location, capacity, and date, view real-time availability, then send a booking request that the venue manager can either approve or decline. No money moves until that approval happens.

When a customer opens the request form they will have to supply the event date, expected guest count, event type, any special requests, plus their preferred room setup. Once a request reaches the venue, the manager handles everything from a clean, bilingual dashboard where they can confirm or reject, update the calendar, and message the client.

Core flow
• Discover venues → apply filters → open venue page → pick an available slot → submit booking request 
• Venue manager receives notification → reviews the details → approves or rejects → customer receives status update

What I need delivered
• Fully responsive front-end (mobile-first) that covers the search interface, venue profiles, and the multi-step booking wizard 
• Back-end with secure authentication, role-based access (organizer / venue manager / admin), and real-time availability logic 
• Manager dashboard for calendar management, inbox, and venue profile editing 
• Admin console to onboard new venues and manage listings 
• Structured database schema ready for production traffic 
• Clear API documentation so future integrations (online payments, marketing tools) are straightforward 
• Source code in a private repo, cleanly commented, with a short setup guide

Tech stack is flexible; I’m comfortable with common frameworks such as React / Next.js, Flutter, or similar for the front, and Node.js, Django, or Laravel for the back so long as performance and scalability are front of mind.

I’ll review milestones based on working demos: first the search and filter flow, then the booking request pipeline, and finally the dashboards and admin panel. Please include a brief outline of your proposed architecture and any venues-or marketplace projects you’ve shipped before.

analysis.summary_ru: Маркетплейс площадок в Египте для свадеб, корпоративных мероприятий и частных встреч: поиск с фильтрами, доступность в реальном времени, заявки на бронирование, дашборд менеджера площадки и админка. Бюджет 8 USD явно не соответствует объёму работ.

You're building a venue marketplace where organizers filter spaces, check live availability, and send booking requests that managers approve or decline, with a bilingual manager dashboard and admin console on top. I'd start with your first milestone: the search and filter flow, venue profiles, and a live availability check, delivered as a working demo. The request pipeline and dashboards would follow as separate milestones. I'd use Next.js for the front end and Node.js with PostgreSQL for the back end, with role-based auth and calendar logic kept in its own module so it scales. The full scope is far beyond the 8 USD budget, so I'd suggest we agree on a price and timeline for the first milestone only. Do you already have a database schema or designs? Which milestone matters most to you first?

title: Bilingual AI Telegram FAQ Bot
description:
I want to deploy an AI-powered Telegram chatbot that can instantly resolve the majority of common questions my customers send us. The bot must draw its answers from three knowledge sources that I will supply: 
• a curated list of FAQs with their answers, 
• the live content on our website and help pages, and 
• uploaded reference files such as PDFs or user guides. 

When the bot cannot generate a confident reply, it should simply tell the user that it does not know and politely direct them to contact our support team—no escalation to a human agent or follow-up questioning is required. 

Replies have to be fluent in English and one additional language (I will confirm which second language we need once the build starts). Language detection and automatic switching would be ideal, but I am open to a simple command-based approach if that is more reliable. 

Deliverables 
• A fully functional Telegram bot hosted on my own server or a recommended cloud platform 
• An admin-friendly way to update the FAQ list, add or replace website URLs, and upload new documents without redeploying code 
• Clear instructions for initial setup, ongoing maintenance, and adding the second language

title: WhatsApp AI Restaurant Ordering Platform
description:
# Project Title

**Build a Complete AI-Powered WhatsApp Restaurant Ordering and Delivery Management System**

## Project Description

I have a WhatsApp Business number and an existing interactive HTML prototype that demonstrates the required design and ordering workflow. I will provide this prototype as a reference.

I need the prototype converted into a fully operational production system connected to my WhatsApp Business number using the official **WhatsApp Business Platform / Meta Cloud API**.

I do not want another HTML demonstration or an unofficial solution that depends on WhatsApp Web, QR code scanning, or keeping a browser open. The final system must be ready for real customer orders.

## Customer Experience Inside WhatsApp

The customer should be able to:

1. Send a message to the restaurant’s WhatsApp number and receive an automatic response in Arabic.
2. Browse an organized menu containing categories, product images, descriptions, and prices.
3. Select products, quantities, sizes, add-ons, removals, and special instructions.
4. review and edit the shopping cart before confirming the order.
5. Automatically receive a calculation containing:
 - Product prices.
 - Add-ons.
 - Delivery fee.
 - Value-added tax at a configurable rate.
 - Final total.
6. Provide the delivery address by:
 - Typing the address.
 - Sharing a WhatsApp location.
7. Receive the calculated distance, estimated delivery time, and delivery fee using Google Maps.
8. Select one of the following payment methods:
 - Cash or card upon delivery.
 - An automatically generated online payment link, with payment status confirmation.
9. Receive an order number, invoice, order summary, and estimated delivery time.
10. Receive automatic notifications as the order status changes until delivery is completed.

The customer-facing ordering experience should take place inside WhatsApp without requiring the customer to visit a separate website.

## Restaurant and Cashier Integration

The restaurant or cashier must have access to:

- New orders in real time.
- Product details, customizations, quantities, notes, address, location, total, and payment method.
- The ability to download or print the order invoice.
- Accepting or rejecting orders.
- Setting the expected preparation time.
- Updating the order status:
 - New.
 - Accepted.
 - Preparing.
 - Ready for pickup.
- Automatically assigning the order to an available driver.
- Manually changing the assigned driver when necessary.
- Managing menu categories, products, prices, images, add-ons, unavailable products, and business hours.

## Driver Integration

The driver should receive:

- Order details.
- Restaurant location.
- Customer address and shared location.
- Delivery distance and estimated travel time.
- A direct Google Maps navigation link.
- Customer contact details when permitted.
- Payment collection information.

The driver must be able to update the order status:

- Order accepted.
- Arrived at the restaurant.
- Order collected.
- On the way to the customer.
- Delivered.
- Delivery failed.

Each status update must automatically reach the customer, restaurant, and administration.

## Owner and Administration Dashboard

I need a secure administration dashboard that allows me to:

- Monitor all orders and statuses in real time.
- Add and manage restaurants, branches, cashiers, and drivers.
- Manage user roles and permissions.
- Edit menus, prices, VAT, delivery fees, delivery zones, and business hours.
- View sales, orders, payments, cancellations, and delivery reports.
- Monitor the performance of each restaurant, branch, cashier, and driver.
- Search and filter historical orders.
- View a complete log of messages, order changes, and user actions.
- Manually intervene in any order when an exception occurs.
- Export reports when needed.

The system should be designed so additional restaurants, branches, and drivers can be added in the future.

## Artificial Intelligence Requirements

The AI assistant must:

- Communicate naturally in Arabic.
- Understand Saudi dialect, common spelling mistakes, and free-text requests.
- Answer questions about the menu, prices, opening hours, delivery, payments, and order status.
- Guide the customer through the full ordering process.
- Use a restaurant-specific knowledge base.
- Recognize when it cannot resolve an issue and transfer the case to an employee or administrator.
- Avoid inventing products, prices, policies, or delivery information.
- Keep replies professional, short, and easy for customers to understand.

Product prices, taxes, delivery fees, payment status, and order status must be calculated and controlled by the application and database. They must not depend on AI-generated calculations.

Order reception, calculation, notifications, restaurant forwarding, and driver assignment should operate automatically. Manual intervention should only be required for exceptional cases or physical preparation of the food.

## Technical Requirements

- Use the official **WhatsApp Business Platform / Meta Cloud API**.
- No unofficial WhatsApp Web automation or permanent QR code connection.
- Attempt to connect my current WhatsApp Business App number using Meta’s **Coexistence** option if my account is eligible.
- Do not delete, migrate, deactivate, or disconnect my current WhatsApp number without my written approval.
- Use a secure production database and hosting environment.
- Provide automatic backups and basic system monitoring.
- Secure all Meta, Google Maps, AI, payment gateway, and server credentials.
- Integrate Google Maps for distance, route, and estimated travel time.
- Integrate a payment gateway suitable for Saudi Arabia. I will provide the merchant account and required credentials.
- Confirm payment automatically through the payment gateway callback or webhook.
- Provide an Arabic interface for the restaurant, driver, and administration.
- Ensure mobile compatibility for cashier and driver interfaces.
- Maintain clear order and system logs.

## Ownership and Handover

At completion, I must receive:

- Full source code.
- Database and database structure.
- Hosting and deployment access.
- Meta application and WhatsApp Business assets.
- Domain and server access.
- All administrator accounts and credentials.
- Google Maps, AI, and payment integration configurations.
- Deployment instructions.
- Basic documentation explaining how to operate and update the system.

All production accounts, Meta assets, hosting services, domains, and third-party services must be registered under my ownership.

The developer must provide at least **30 days of bug-fixing support** after final delivery.

## Delivery Time

I need a working and activated version within **two days**, provided that Meta approvals, payment gateway approval, and other external service credentials are available.

Before accepting the project, the freelancer must clearly identify:

- What can be completed within 48 hours.
- Any steps that require Meta or third-party approval.
- Any external factor that could delay activation.
- Any information, documents, or credentials required from me.

Delays caused by external approvals should be identified before the project begins.

## Final Acceptance Test

The project will only be considered completed after successfully testing a real order from beginning to end on my WhatsApp number:

1. A customer sends a message and receives an AI response.
2. The customer browses the menu.
3. The customer selects a meal, add-ons, and quantity.
4. The customer edits the order.
5. The customer types an address or shares a WhatsApp location.
6. The system correctly calculates product prices, delivery fees, VAT, and the final total.
7. The customer selects cash on delivery or online payment.
8. The restaurant receives the complete order immediately.
9. The order is assigned to a driver.
10. The driver receives the locations, distance, and Google Maps route.
11. Order status updates are sent automatically to the customer.
12. The completed order appears correctly in the administration reports.
13. Multiple test orders are completed without errors.
14. The full source code, accounts, access permissions, and documentation are transferred to me.

Screenshots, recorded videos, or a separate demonstration environment will not count as final delivery. The system must work on my actual accounts and WhatsApp number.

## Payment Terms

- **50% upfront through the freelancing platform’s escrow or milestone system** after agreeing on the technical plan, total price, and delivery schedule.
- **50% after the live system passes the acceptance test** and all source code, accounts, credentials, permissions, and documentation are transferred to me.
- The final payment will not be released based only on screenshots or videos.
- The freelancer must provide a fixed development price and clearly list all expected monthly or usage-based costs.

## Questions the Freelancer Must Answer

1. Will you use the official WhatsApp Cloud API?
2. Have you previously developed a similar WhatsApp ordering system? Please provide a working example.
3. Can my existing number remain active in the WhatsApp Business App through Coexistence?
4. What can you realistically complete within 48 hours?
5. What accounts, documents, approvals, and credentials do you need from me?
6. Which programming technologies, database, and hosting service will you use?
7. Will I receive the complete source code and ownership of all accounts?
8. How will the payment gateway, Google Maps, AI assistant, restaurant, and driver systems be connected?

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет получить готовую систему приёма заказов через WhatsApp Business на официальном Meta Cloud API: меню, корзина, расчёт НДС и доставки через Google Maps, панели для ресторана, водителей и администратора, а также ИИ-ассистент. Бюджет 30 USD явно не соответствует объёму работ.
analysis.reply:
You need a production WhatsApp ordering system on the official Meta Cloud API, covering the Arabic auto-reply, the menu with cart and add-ons, VAT and delivery-fee calculation through Google Maps, and status notifications for the restaurant, drivers and admin. I would start with the Cloud API webhook and the customer ordering flow, since everything else depends on it, then add the restaurant order board and driver status updates. Using modern tooling and AI-assisted development, I can deliver the first phase in about 1–2 weeks. The full scope is larger than 30 USD, so I would suggest splitting it into milestones.

Could you tell me whether the 30 USD budget covers only the first milestone? Also, the AI assistant section of the brief was cut off, so could you share the complete spec?

See my live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

Вам нужна рабочая система приёма заказов через WhatsApp на официальном Meta Cloud API: автоответ на арабском, меню с корзиной и добавками, расчёт НДС и стоимости доставки через Google Maps, уведомления о статусах для ресторана, водителей и администратора. Я бы начал с webhook Cloud API и потока заказа для клиента, так как от этого зависит всё остальное, а затем добавил бы панель заказов для ресторана и обновление статусов для водителей. Используя современные инструменты и разработку с ИИ-ассистентами, могу сдать первую фазу примерно за 1–2 недели. Полный объём больше 30 USD, поэтому предлагаю разбить проект на этапы.

Подскажите, пожалуйста, бюджет 30 USD покрывает только первый этап? Также раздел о ИИ-ассистенте в описании обрезан, можете прислать полное техническое задание?

Живые демо смотрите здесь: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

title: Mobile app developer needed for a restaurant ordering and delivery app
description:
I'm developing "Savora Kitchen," a mobile app where my customers can browse the menu, build an order, pay securely and choose delivery or pickup. The aim is simple: make ordering so easy that people never need to call or visit a separate website.

The app should include:

- Easy menu browsing by category, with photos, descriptions and optional add-ons
- A live cart and checkout that handles promo codes, tax and delivery fees
- Secure payments through Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay or Google Pay (tell me which you're strongest with)
- Push notifications confirming each order and updating its status through to "out for delivery"
- GPS tracking for customers and a courier view, or live status updates at the very least
- A simple admin panel where I can update menu items, prices and time slots and close out orders
- Clear analytics on daily sales, top-selling items and returning customers

I'm open on technology. Flutter, React Native, native Kotlin/Swift or another modern stack all work, as long as I get iOS and Android builds plus the full source code. The backend can be Node, Firebase, Laravel or whatever you prefer. It should store menu data, orders and user profiles, and expose an API I can build on later.

When the project is finished, I'll expect an Android APK and an iOS TestFlight build that are ready for store submission. I'll also need the source code with a clear README for local setup, and either a basic admin portal or documented Firebase console settings. To finish, a short handover call or video walkthrough so I can manage updates on my own.

If you've built food ordering or e-commerce apps before, please share links or screenshots. I'd like to see how you handle UI and the order flow. I'm excited to make Savora Kitchen the first place my customers go when they're hungry.

I'd build it in Flutter for one codebase on iOS and Android, with Firebase handling auth, orders and push, so the data layer is simple and ready for an API later. I'd start with the ordering flow and admin panel, then add courier tracking. A first working version with an APK and TestFlight build would take roughly 4–6 weeks. The full scope is larger than 700 USD covers, so a phased plan may suit better.

title: AI Telegram Support Chatbot Build
description:
I need a Telegram-based customer support assistant that can answer routine questions, look up order or account details when a user provides an order number, and smoothly escalate anything beyond its scope to a human agent. 

All of the reference material it draws from will live in internal PDFs and Word documents; there is no public help-centre site, so I’ll provide those files during development. The bot should read those documents, index the content, and use a reliable LLM (OpenAI, Claude or similar) to generate concise, helpful replies. Accuracy is critical—answers must reflect the wording in the files, not hallucinate. 

When a customer types an order number the chatbot should query our existing order database or a simple API endpoint I will expose, then return the relevant status or details. If the user’s request falls outside the preset knowledge base or requires sensitive changes, the conversation must be flagged and handed off to a live agent, with full transcript preserved. 

Deliverables
• Complete, self-hosted Telegram bot (Python preferred, but I’m open to Node.js) 
• Document ingestion pipeline that pulls text from supplied PDFs/Word and updates the knowledge base on demand 
• Order-lookup integration triggered by an order number field 
• Human-handoff logic with webhook or email alert 
• Clear setup guide and commented source code 

Acceptance criteria
• Bot responds accurately to at least 90% of a supplied test suite derived from the documents. 
• Order status returned in <3 s for typical queries. 
• Escalation kicks in automatically when confidence is low or a user types “agent”. 

I have hosting ready and can create the Telegram bot token on request. Let me know your relevant experience with Telegram Bot API, vector stores, and language models, plus an estimated timeline.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен Telegram-бот поддержки, который отвечает на типовые вопросы по внутренним PDF и Word-документам, проверяет статус заказа по номеру и передаёт диалог живому оператору, если уверенность низкая или пользователь пишет «agent». Бюджет низкий для такого объёма работ.
analysis.reply:
You want a Telegram support assistant that answers from your PDF and Word documents, looks up orders by number, and hands off to a human when it's unsure or when a user types "agent". I'd build it in Python with python-telegram-bot. The ingestion step would parse the files, chunk them, and store embeddings in a local vector store. Retrieval would feed an LLM instructed to quote the source wording, with a confidence threshold that triggers handoff and sends the full transcript by webhook or email. The order lookup would be a small adapter around your endpoint or database. A working version with the test suite and setup guide would take about 1.5 to 2 weeks. You can see live demos in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Could you share sample documents and the order API format? Which LLM provider do you prefer?

Yakov

Вам нужен помощник поддержки в Telegram, который отвечает по вашим PDF и Word-документам, ищет заказы по номеру и передаёт диалог человеку, когда не уверен в ответе или когда пользователь пишет «agent». Я бы сделал его на Python с python-telegram-bot. На этапе загрузки документы разбираются на фрагменты, а эмбеддинги хранятся в локальном векторном хранилище. Поиск заказа будет небольшим адаптером к вашему эндпоинту или базе данных. Рабочая версия с тестовым набором и инструкцией по установке займёт примерно 1,5–2 недели. title: Secure Student Election Voting Portal
description:
Project Title: Full-Stack Web Developer — Student Council Election Polling Software (STD XI & XII)

We need an experienced Full-Stack Web Developer to build a secure, user-friendly Student Council Election Polling Web Application for senior secondary school elections (STD XI & XII), replacing manual paper ballots and counting. 

Key Requirements:

Branding, Themes & Ballot Rules: Admin controls for School Name, Logo upload (PNG/JPG/WEBP), Voting Year (dropdown + custom entry), 4 switchable UI themes (Emerald Teal, Royal Navy, Imperial Purple, Midnight Slate), and configurable selection rules (default 7 candidates per class with mandatory at least 1 Boy and 1 Girl in both STD XI & XII).

Scheduled Voting Window: Admin Start Time and End Time pickers that automatically block Student/Teacher logins before opening and lock voting immediately at closing.

Bulk CSV & Photo Uploads: Class-wise Candidates CSV upload, Voters CSV upload (Students & Teachers with live Voted/Pending status), and batch alphabetical photo upload that auto-maps images to the alphabetical candidate list.

Authentication & Single-Vote Guarantee: Login via Full Name + GRNO/Staff ID, user self-service password change after login, Admin one-click bulk password reset back to default IDs, and strict one-vote-per-user enforcement with timestamp locking.

2-Step Class-Wise Ballots: Separate STD XI and STD XII voting screens displaying candidate photos and checkboxes alphabetically, with a live counter validating the required selection count and Boy/Girl rule before enabling the VOTE button.

Final Results & Audit Log: Rank-sorted, printable, and CSV-exportable Final Result Reports (Class XI & XII candidate totals, Total Votes Cast, and separate Student vs. Teacher turnout), plus an end-of-election "Who Voted For Whom" audit report unlocked once voting ends.

as per you, which tech stack (e.g., .NET 8 + MSSQL, PHP/MySQL, Python, etc.) do you recommend for fast, reliable deployment?

title: Web Design: Cloaked Table Events, immersive entertainment brand
description:
About Us

We are looking for an experienced, creative website designer to build a professional, visually striking website for Cloaked Table Events, a new UK immersive entertainment brand combining mystery, deception, strategy, audience participation and theatrical entertainment.

We currently have three event concepts:

The Cloaked Table – Our flagship immersive experience, including theatrical dining events.

The Cloaked Trials – A full-day experience featuring outdoor challenges and immersive gameplay.

The Cloaked Table Corporate – Interactive corporate entertainment and team-building experiences.

We have an established brand identity, logo, photography, video footage, website mock-ups and marketing materials that will be supplied.

Design & Functionality

We want a website that feels like entering a world of mystery and suspense. The design should be dark, cinematic and atmospheric, incorporating dramatic photography, video, elegant typography and subtle gold and red accents. Thematically, our events are based around 'The Traitors' TV programme. 

The website should feel premium and exciting whilst remaining user-friendly, particularly on mobile devices.

We are not looking for complex bespoke development. Our preference is an established platform such as WordPress or Wix that our team can easily manage and update independently, although we are open to recommendations.

Website Structure

We envisage approximately 6–8 pages or templates:

Homepage – Dramatic introduction, featured events and clear booking options.

Upcoming Events – Searchable event listings with dates, locations, prices and booking links.

Our Experiences – Overview of our event formats.

The Cloaked Table – Dedicated flagship experience page.

The Cloaked Trials – Dedicated full-day experience page.

Corporate & Private Events – Information and booking enquiry form.

Venues & Partnerships – Information for prospective venue partners.

About / Contact – Company information, contact details and enquiry form.

We are happy to combine pages where appropriate to remain within budget.

Essential Features

Professional, responsive and mobile-friendly design.

Easy-to-use content management system.

Ability to add and update events, dates, venues, prices and imagery.

Event listings with date and location filters.

Online ticket booking or third-party ticketing integration.

Corporate and private booking enquiry forms.

Social media integration.

Basic SEO and Google Analytics setup.

Cookie consent and SSL/security configuration.

Basic training and handover.

Ticketing Requirements

We have not yet selected a ticketing provider and welcome recommendations on two approaches:

Option A: Integration with an established third-party ticketing provider.

Option B: Direct ticket purchases through our website.

We would like to understand the setup costs, ongoing charges, ticketing fees and administrative advantages of each option. A bespoke ticketing platform is not required.

Design Reference

We like the event listings and search functionality of www.murder57.com, but our website must have its own distinctive design and brand identity.

Budget & Timescale

Budget: £500–£800 for the initial website.

We are seeking a fixed-price quotation with a clear breakdown of deliverables and a realistic delivery timescale.

What to Include in Your Proposal

Please provide:

Examples of previously designed websites.

Recommended website platform and reasons for choosing it.

Fixed-price quotation and breakdown of deliverables.

Estimated completion timescale.

Recommended ticketing solution and associated costs.

Ongoing hosting, maintenance and licence fees.

Confirmation of full website ownership and administrator access.

Details of included training, support and revisions.

Experience in events, entertainment, hospitality, leisure or ticket-selling websites would be particularly advantageous.

Our objective is to launch a professional, engaging and scalable website that establishes Cloaked Table Events as a recognisable entertainment brand and provides a strong foundation for future growth.

title: DealerMargin Autotrader integration – developer review brief
description:
We need an experienced PHP developer to review DealerMargin's Autotrader Connect stock integration before go-live, then maintain it. The code is built and working in Autotrader's sandbox. This is a review, fix and sign-off job, not a build.
Background
DealerMargin is a UK web app for small used-car dealers (stock, margin-scheme VAT, invoices). It's plain PHP 8 and MySQL on Cloudways. We're an Autotrader Connect partner (Stock and Media Updates). Autotrader's AI policy requires AI-assisted code to be owned by a competent developer, so we need you to review it and be our named technical contact.
DealerMargin logs in to Autotrader with one partner key. Dealers only give us their advertiser ID.
What's built
About 1,000 lines of PHP:
• includes/autotrader.php: login with a cached 15-minute token, retries (429, 503, 401), registration lookup, image upload, and stock create, update, sold and delete
• vehicle_edit.php: syncs when a car's details, photos or sale change; shows the car's Autotrader status and destination tickboxes
• settings.php: dealer enters their advertiser ID, checked against GET /advertisers
• autotrader_import.php: one-off import of a dealer's existing Autotrader stock
• autotrader_test.php: founder-only test bench showing every request and response
Tested in the sandbox on 25 Nov 2026: create (201), duplicate create (409, then the existing advert is adopted), update, sold and delete all work.
What to review
1.  Requests match Autotrader's spec (Stock, Media, Vehicles, Advertisers), including the sold and deleted payloads
2.  Security: keys and tokens never leak; the token cache can't be read over the web; dealers can only reach their own cars; the test bench is locked down
3.  Failure handling when Autotrader is slow or down
4.  Only the data Autotrader needs is sent (never buyer details)
5.  Code quality and PHP 8 compatibility
6.  Readiness for Autotrader's go-live checks
Known gaps
• GET /stock/{id} returns "not found" in the sandbox, so we can't read one advert back
• Sync runs while the dealer waits: should it move to a queue?
• A failed sync is only retried when the dealer next saves the car
• No CSRF tokens anywhere in the app
• Database columns are added on first use, not by migrations
Access
Code is shared as a zip after an NDA. You'll test with our sandbox partner credentials and a founder login on test advertiser 66897. Nothing touches live Autotrader until the go-live checks pass.
Deliverables
Phase 1 (fixed price):
[ ] A written review, with issues ranked by severity
[ ] Fixes as changed files, with change notes
[ ] Sign-off that you're happy to own the integration
[ ] Support with Autotrader's go-live demo if they ask for one
Phase 2 (retainer or hourly): be the named technical contact, fix issues, and keep up with API changes.
About you
You have solid PHP 8, MySQL and REST/OAuth experience, ideally including Autotrader Connect or other UK motor-trade feeds, and you work UK hours.
To apply
Send:
• Similar integrations you've done
• Your Phase 1 price and timescale
• Your Phase 2 rate
• One question you'd ask about the code

analysis.summary_ru: Ревью, исправление и сопровождение PHP 8-интеграции со складом Autotrader Connect для сервиса дилеров DealerMargin перед запуском. Нужен также постоянный технический контакт для обновлений API.
analysis.reply:
You need the Autotrader Connect integration in DealerMargin reviewed before go-live: request shapes against the Stock, Media, Vehicles and Advertisers specs, token caching and retries, whether any buyer data leaks into payloads, and locking down the test bench and token cache. I'd work through those areas in that order, rank findings by severity, and deliver fixes as changed files with notes, then sign off with a clear list of anything still open. The known gaps (queued sync, retrying failed syncs beyond the next save, CSRF, columns added on first use) I'd scope as separate items so you can prioritise them. Rough timeline: 1–2 weeks for the review and fixes once I have the zip and sandbox access, depending on how many issues turn up. You can see live demos at https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Two questions: is the go-live demo date already fixed? And should moving sync to a queue be part of Phase 1 or left for Phase 2?

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужно проверить интеграцию DealerMargin с Autotrader Connect перед запуском: соответствие запросов спецификациям Stock, Media, Vehicles и Advertisers, кэширование токенов и повторные запросы, отсутствие данных покупателей в payload, а также защиту тестового стенда и кэша токенов. Я бы прошёл эти области в таком порядке, ранжировал найденные проблемы по серьёзности, передал исправления измененными файлами с пояснениями и затем дал заключение со списком оставшихся вопросов. Известные пробелы (очередь для синхронизации, повтор неудачной синхронизации не только при следующем сохранении, CSRF, колонки, добавляемые при первом использовании) я бы выделил в отдельные пункты, чтобы вы могли расставить приоритеты. Ориентировочный срок: 1–2 недели на ревью и исправления после получения архива и доступа к сендбоксу, в зависимости от количества найденных проблем. title: Desktop Thermometer App Field Trial
description:
Join CoolRater’s winter 2026–27 field trial of a Windows app that measures the Heat-Transfer Coefficient of your home, a statistic used to support heat-pump sizing. Participants will install the app, connect an Octopus Energy account, provide half-hourly smart-meter data, and collect overnight temperatures using four Elitech RC-5+ loggers, which will be provided. Applicants must heat their home with a gas boiler and avoid using energy outside the home during trial sessions. Basic computer skills are sufficient; CSV editing and installing unsigned trial software are required. Five participants are sought each month from November 2026 to February 2027.

CoolRater is a desktop app which will measure the heat transfer coefficient HTC for a building, a function that has become increasingly important in recent years for use in sizing heat pumps. A field trial is being run this winter with these objectives:

1. To obtain temperature and energy data for a range of properties. Currently CoolRater has only been used for the author’s own property.

2. to obtain data from properties where the temperature varies between locations due to variations in insulation or heat distribution. For example close to a solid floor with no insulation, or in rooms which do not have double glazing.

3. To find out if users have any problems in using the app, or have any dislikes or need for additional features or improvements.

There are some specific requirements for participants:

1. The app only supports Windows (10 or 11);
2. heating must be with a gas boiler;
3. your energy supplier must be Octopus Energy, and you must be able to connect to the Octopus API, which means that you will have to live in the UK.
4. you must have a smart meter, configured to record energy use every 30 minutes. As a quick check that the smart meter and API is working correctly, there is a feature on the Octopus website where you can download smart meter data. Log in to your Octopus account, click your name top right, click My Energy, scroll down to "Get your energy geek on" you can download files of energy usage. Please download two days of energy data and attach it to your proposal, so that I can see that you have a working smart meter.
5. during the trial, which is only active at night, you will not be able to use energy for anything outside the house, like charging EVs.

To collect the temperature data you will be provided with four Elitech RC-5+ logging thermometers. To send you these, I will need your address. Exchanging contact details is discouraged by PPH rules, but is allowed after a proposal has been accepted if it is necessary to mail equipment. Note that a similar project is also posted which differs only in that participants buy their own thermometers, receive a higher amount as a result, and do not therefore need to provide their address.

A high level of computer expertise is not required but you will need to copy your API key from your Octopus account to the app, you may need to edit CSV files with Excel or LibraOffice, and install the app. As trial software it has not been possible to digitally sign it and it has had few downloads. Therefore the operating system will treat it with suspicion and advise you not to run it. You can run it against this advice by clicking “More Information” and “Run Anyway”.

The video https://youtu.be/HryknL9LGqQ gives instructions on using the app and shows what you will need to do as a participant in the field trial.

Criteria for Job Completion

As trial software its difficult to be certain of how well it will work. The app calculates the HTC for each inside thermometer by three different methods. If for any one of the thermometers the results agree to within 10%, then jobs a good’un. If they don’t, then this often indicates a problem with the thermometer being close to a heating source. So I would like you to repeat the test one or two times to get a better result. Return either one project file with the results agreeing to within 10%, or three project files from three separate attempts.

It is intended that there will be five participants in each of the months November 2026 to February 2027.

Нужно быть владельцем дома в Великобритании с газовым котлом, Octopus Energy и умным счётчиком, а также устанавливать ПО и собирать данные с термометров. Это участие в исследовании, а не разработка.

title: Informational App Concept Development

• A simple user flow that lets people land, grasp the value proposition in seconds, and dive deeper through well-structured sections or screens. 
• Modern, accessible design that feels optimistic and forward-looking, aligned with the “tomorrow” theme. 
• Low-fidelity wireframes evolving into high-fidelity mock-ups and, ideally, an interactive prototype (Figma or Adobe XD preferred).

2. High-fidelity designs reflect the approved visual direction and follow WCAG accessibility basics. 
3. Prototype links are shareable for stakeholder testing and feedback. 
4. Final hand-off includes editable design files and a brief documentation PDF.

If you’re comfortable shaping an informative experience from the ground up—and can iterate quickly on feedback—I’d love to see a short note with one relevant sample.

title: GoHighLevel expert wanted to automate lead flow for a home-service company
description:
My home-service business already runs on GoHighLevel, but we're barely using what it can do. I'm looking for a GoHighLevel specialist to set up our leads, pipelines and follow-ups so every new inquiry is routed, tracked and nurtured automatically, without anyone on my team chasing it by hand.

Here's what I need help with:

- Building a complete pipeline that follows each customer from first contact to a finished job
- Setting up triggers, tags and smart lists that move prospects through the stages on their own
- Creating follow-up sequences across email, SMS and voicemail drops, timed to keep homeowners engaged until they book
- Providing snapshot backups and simple documentation so we can adjust things as our services or seasons change

I see this as an ongoing working relationship rather than a one-off build. That means short sprints for new campaigns, refinements after testing and regular check-ins on the analytics dashboard to find where leads are slipping through.

If you know GoHighLevel inside out and can turn real home-service workflows into clean, reliable automations, I'd like to hear from you. Tell me briefly how you'd approach the build and share any similar setups you've done.

Нужен также бэкап, документация и долгосрочная поддержка спринтами.

You want every inquiry routed, tracked and nurtured automatically, from first contact through to a finished job, without anyone chasing leads by hand. My approach: first map your current lead sources and stages, then build the pipeline, tags and smart lists so prospects move between stages on triggers. On top of that I'd set up the email, SMS and voicemail sequences with timing that keeps homeowners engaged until they book. I'd test each sequence on a small batch, then deliver a snapshot and short documentation so your team can adjust things when services or seasons change. A first version of the pipeline and one follow-up sequence could be ready in about 1–2 weeks, with refinements in sprints after that.

Key Requirements:

Tech Stack: C# / ASP.NET Core (.NET 8.0), EF Core, MSSQL Server, responsive dashboard UI (MVC/Razor, React, or Bootstrap/Tailwind + Chart.js/ApexCharts), QuestPDF, and ClosedXML/OpenXML.

Interactive Controls: UI checkboxes to toggle participating evaluator roles per cycle/department (dynamically updating rubric columns, routing, and averages) plus multi-select staff actions.

Universal File Upload & Bulk Import: Support manual entry and .xlsx/.csv/.docx/image/PDF uploads across all modules (branding, staff master, dynamic rubric statements, evidence attachments, offline ratings, and signatures).

Dynamic 4-Page Rubric & Strict Security: Section A (60%) & Section B (40%) auto-scaling engine, strict backend API-level confidentiality per role, Principal one-click score release, and dual-stage 4-page PDF exports (Self-Appraisal & Final Released).

Deliverables: Complete Visual Studio solution (.sln), MSSQL scripts/migrations, sample import templates, deployment guide (IIS or Linux Nginx/systemd), and full QA sign-off.

title: PLC-Based Mushroom Farm Monitoring
description:
I run a mushroom facility and need a complete, shop-floor-to-cloud solution that keeps an eye on temperature and humidity, pushes the readings to a web dashboard I can open on any phone or computer, and immediately sends a WhatsApp alert whenever either value drifts outside the limits I set.

The sensing side will rely on PLC-grade temperature and humidity probes wired directly into the control panel. I need you to handle both the PLC logic and the supporting hardware design so the installation is tidy, reliable, and easy to maintain.

Once the PLC collects the data, the values must be published to my server where a lightweight web interface presents current readings, historical trends, and the threshold settings I can edit myself. When the PLC detects an out-of-range condition it should trigger a message through the server to my WhatsApp number with the exact parameter, time stamp, and current reading.

Deliverables that will let me accept the project: 
• Hardware layout: sensor model selection, wiring diagram, and bill of materials 
• PLC program with commented logic for data acquisition, limit checking, and network hand-off 
• Server-side script or API bridge that receives the PLC packet, stores it, drives the dashboard, and pushes WhatsApp messages (Twilio API or equivalent is fine) 
• Responsive web dashboard (simple, clean, HTML5/JS or similar) showing live and historical data plus editable limits 
• Remote test session proving alerts fire correctly when you simulate a high or low reading

I can supply network details and physical panel photos once we start; everything else—from sensor calibration to final commissioning—should come from you.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчику нужна система мониторинга температуры и влажности на грибной ферме: данные с ПЛК передаются на сервер, отображаются в адаптивном веб-дашборде с редактируемыми порогами и отправляют алерты в WhatsApp. Большая часть работы связана с ПЛК-логикой и монтажом оборудования, а бюджет очень мал (1250 INR).
analysis.reply:
You want sensor readings to travel from the PLC to a server, show up on a phone-friendly dashboard with editable limits, and trigger a WhatsApp alert with the parameter, timestamp and value whenever a threshold is crossed.

I would handle the server side: an endpoint that receives the PLC packet, stores the readings, serves the dashboard, and sends alerts through the Twilio WhatsApp API. The dashboard would be responsive HTML/JS with live values, history charts and threshold inputs. I can deliver the software part in about 5 to 7 days, including a remote test where we simulate high and low readings to confirm the alerts fire.

PLC programming and panel wiring are outside my core focus, so for those you may want a local automation specialist. We could agree on the packet format first so the two sides fit together.

Which PLC model and communication method (Modbus TCP, HTTP or MQTT) are you planning to use? Do you already have a Twilio account with a WhatsApp sender?

Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужно, чтобы показания датчиков передавались с ПЛК на сервер, отображались в адаптивном дашборде с редактируемыми порогами, а при выходе за пределы приходил алерт в WhatsApp с параметром, временной меткой и значением.

Я бы взялся за серверную часть: эндпоинт, который принимает пакет от ПЛК, сохраняет показания, отдаёт дашборд и отправляет алерты через WhatsApp API Twilio. Дашборд — адаптивный HTML/JS с текущими значениями, графиками истории и полями для порогов. title: Приложение под win - работа с COM портом
description: Необходимо простое приложение под windows, размер и оформление примерно как калькулятор в windows. Необходимо окно для отображения сообщений от устройства и возможность отправлять свои фиксированные команды в COM порт с помощью кнопок - каждая кнопка - одна команда, нажал - отправил в COM порт на устройство. Действующий пример из общедоступного ПО - Arduino IDE, в нём есть монитор COM порта, его функционал закрывает задачу, но неудобно постоянно вводить команду вручную. Из настроек: выбор COM порта из присутствующих в системе, изменение скорости COM порта (все стандартные скорости, при запуске программы по умолчанию ставить скорость 115200 и выбор из выпадающего списка), каждую кнопку с командой чтобы можно было переименовывать (у каждой кнопки 2 параметра - название кнопки (название команды) и непосредственно сама команда которая отправляется в порт, оба параметра редактируемые, если у кнопки нет названия то вместо названия подписывать кнопку командой.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужно простое Windows-приложение в стиле калькулятора: окно для сообщений от устройства, выбор COM-порта и скорости (по умолчанию 115200), а также редактируемые кнопки, каждая из которых отправляет свою команду в порт. Бюджет 3000 ₽ низковат для такого объёма.
analysis.reply:
Вам нужно Windows-приложение: окно с сообщениями от устройства, выбор COM-порта и скорости (по умолчанию 115200), а также кнопки, каждая из которых отправляет свою команду в порт. Названия и команды кнопок должны редактироваться, а кнопка без названия показывает саму команду. Я бы сделал это на Python: pyserial для работы с портом и tkinter или PyQt для интерфейса, настройки и кнопки сохранял бы в JSON, а в конце собрал бы exe. description:

Разрабатываем систему интеллектуального поиска и анализа документов с управлением через диалог с языковой моделью.

title: Cross-Platform Fantasy Cricket App
description:
I’m looking for a mobile developer (or team) who can turn my concept of a fantasy-cricket platform into polished Android and iOS apps. The core experience is familiar to any cricket fantasy fan: users create or join contests, follow live match data, and watch their ranking climb in real time as every ball is bowled.

Key gameplay & data requirements 
• Contests can be both free and paid. When it’s a paid entry, the user may tap an in-app wallet balance or go straight through card, QR, or other mobile payment methods whichever is most convenient. 
• While a match is live the app must stream three layers of data together: match score + status, player-by-player fantasy points, and a constantly updating contest leaderboard. These feeds need to feel instantaneous; I don’t mind which data provider you prefer as long as latency stays negligible. 
• At match end the system should lock scores, publish results, credit winnings automatically, and archive everything in the user’s history.

Scope you would handle 
• Build native or cross-platform codebase (open to suggestions) 
• Secure backend with robust scoring engine, wallet ledger, and admin controls 
• Payment gateway integrations for card, QR and popular mobile wallets 
• Push notifications for lineup deadlines, live score milestones, and winnings credit 
• Basic UI/UX that can be reskinned later without heavy refactoring 
• Deployment to App Store & Play Store, plus handoff of source code and documentation

There’s no strict launch deadline; I prefer a thoughtful, well-tested roll-out over a rushed MVP. If you have prior experience with live-sports data, payment flows, or similar fantasy apps, let’s talk through your approach, data feed suggestions, and a realistic milestone plan.

title: Upscale Photography E-commerce Site
description:
I need an elegant, modern website that showcases my fine-art photographs and lets visitors choose a photo, pick a size, and place an order that I will print and ship myself. The entire experience should feel premium: crisp full-screen galleries, smooth animations, and a clean, minimalist layout that keeps the imagery front-and-center on both desktop and mobile. 

Core shopping flow 
• Browsing: visitors can search or filter by collection, subject, or even dominant color to find the perfect shot. 
• Detail view: each image must open in a fast, high-resolution lightbox so buyers can zoom in and inspect texture and sharpness before committing. 
• Favorites: users can add photos to a private favorites list, then move selected pieces straight into the cart when ready. 
• Checkout: payments go through a secure, integrated gateway that accepts major cards and digital wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, etc.). 

Back-end management 
I need an intuitive dashboard to upload new photos, assign them to collections, set multiple print sizes with individual prices, cap edition counts when necessary, and track orders. If you propose WordPress + WooCommerce, Shopify, or another platform, please explain why it fits a gallery-style storefront. 

Deliverables 
1. Fully responsive website, live on my domain and SSL-secured. 
2. Custom-styled gallery templates with the three features above working smoothly. 
3. Payment gateway configured in test and live modes. 
4. Documentation (or short Loom video) showing how I add new photos, edit sizes, and fulfill orders. 

Acceptance criteria 
• Page load under 3 s on a standard broadband connection with WebP or next-gen image formats. 
• Filters return results instantly and zoom remains pixel-sharp. 
• End-to-end test order processes successfully with a sandbox card. 

Timeframe is flexible but I would like to review a staging version within three weeks so we can fine-tune the look before launch.

You want a gallery-style storefront where the photos come first: filters by collection, subject and dominant color, a sharp high-res lightbox, favorites that move into the cart, and a simple dashboard for uploads, multiple print sizes with their own prices, and edition caps. I'd build it as a custom site rather than forcing it into a theme, because the lightbox, the filters and the image pipeline (WebP, responsive sizes, lazy loading) are what make the page feel premium and keep it under your 3-second load target. With AI-assisted development and a modern stack, I can have a staging version ready well inside your three-week window so we can fine-tune the look before launch. The admin panel and a short walkthrough video are included.

Two quick questions: how many collections and print sizes do you expect at launch, and do you already have a domain and hosting, or should I set those up?

title: Data Scraping Dashboard Agent
description:
I need an automated agent that regularly pulls live data from three places I already use—Google Sheets, multiple Shopify stores, and my advertising accounts on Google Ads and Meta Ads—and feeds it straight into a lightweight web-based dashboard. The very first thing I want to see when I open that dashboard is a clean snapshot of sales, orders, and revenue. From there I can drill down into anything else, but those three figures should greet me at the top every time.

Core workflow
• The agent authenticates with each data source, fetches the latest figures on a schedule we agree on (hourly is ideal), and handles retries or API limits gracefully. 
• It then pipes the cleaned, normalized results into the dashboard layer—no exports or manual uploads. 
• The dashboard renders in a browser, responsive on desktop and mobile, with simple filters for date ranges and store/account selection.

Tech flexibility
I am open to whatever stack you find quickest and most reliable—Python with Pandas, Node, Airtable scripts, or low-code tools—so long as the final experience is fast and the code is maintainable. If a small backend database makes aggregation easier, feel free to include it.

Timeline
Speed is important to me; please outline how quickly you can prototype the agent, connect each source, and ship an MVP interface. 

Deliverables
1. Source-controlled code for the agent and dashboard. 
2. A short README covering setup, credentials, and environment variables. 
3. A live demo link or deploy script so I can test the dashboard with my own accounts.

Once the basics are solid I may add additional metrics, but getting the core sales, orders, and revenue view online is the immediate goal.

Главные показатели на первом экране: продажи, заказы и выручка, с фильтрами по датам и магазинам/аккаунтам.

I'd build the fetchers in Python with a small database for aggregation, run them hourly with retries and rate-limit backoff, and serve a lightweight frontend that loads the three headline figures first. Shopify and Sheets are the fastest to connect, so I can have a working prototype with those two in about 3 days and a full MVP with both ad platforms within about a week.

Two questions:
1. Should the first version cover only Shopify and Sheets, with the ad accounts added in a second phase?
2. Do you already have a Google Ads developer token and Meta app access?

Live demos are in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

- Интерфейс. Русский и узбекский на латинице, светлая и тёмная темы, возможность использовать тему Telegram. Приложение должно удобно работать на iPhone и Android.

4. Отдельную оценку стоимости и срока подключения ИИ-перевода.
Подробное ТЗ и примеры экранов предоставлю для оценки.

title: Immediate CodeIgniter Security Breach Fix
description:
My PHP / CodeIgniter wallet web app is under an active attack. Hackers are flipping KYC flags (1 = approved, 0 = rejected, 2 = pending), setting every user’s balance to 0, and forcing accounts to inactive status. Each time I correct the records they reverse the changes within the hour, so the intrusion is still live.

I can give you full access to the hosting control panel, MySQL database, complete source code, and admin area. I also have a clean full backup from before the first signs of tampering.

Here is what I need, in order of urgency:

• Contain the breach right now: block the attacker’s entry points and stop the real-time database edits. 
• Investigate and document how they are getting in—whether through a CodeIgniter vulnerability, weak credentials, or server misconfiguration. 
• Patch the code or configuration, rotate credentials, and harden the server (firewall rules, permissions, least-privilege DB user). 
• Restore correct data from backup where needed and verify data integrity. 
• Monitor logs for at least 48–72 hours to confirm the fix holds.

If you have solid experience with PHP, CodeIgniter, MySQL security, OWASP best practices, and Linux server hardening, I’m ready to onboard you immediately and stay available for any information you need.

analysis.summary_ru: Срочная задача: активная атака на веб-приложение-кошелёк на PHP/CodeIgniter. Злоумышленники меняют KYC-статусы, балансы и статусы аккаунтов. Нужно остановить взлом, найти уязвимость, восстановить данные из бэкапа и укрепить сервер. Бюджет 37 500 INR.
analysis.reply:
You're dealing with an active intrusion where KYC flags, balances and account statuses are being rewritten faster than you can restore them, so containment has to come first. My plan: lock down access by rotating the database and hosting credentials, restricting the admin area by IP or adding 2FA, and revoking suspicious sessions. Then I'd review the CodeIgniter application and server logs to find the entry point, patch it, restore correct data from your clean backup, and check integrity against the logs. I expect containment within the first day and a documented fix with 48–72 hours of monitoring after that, though the exact timeline depends on what the logs show.

You can see examples of my work with live demos here: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Do the attacker's changes come through the web app or through direct database connections? And do you have web server access logs covering the past few weeks?

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вы столкнулись с активным взломом: статусы KYC, балансы и статусы аккаунтов переписываются быстрее, чем вы успеваете их восстанавливать, поэтому сначала нужно локализовать атаку. Мой план: сменить учётные данные базы и хостинга, ограничить доступ к админке по IP или включить 2FA, отозвать подозрительные сессии. Затем я проверю приложение CodeIgniter и логи сервера, найду точку входа, устраню её, восстановлю корректные данные из чистого бэкапа и сверю целостность по логам. Ожидаю локализацию взлома в первый день и задокументированное исправление с последующим мониторингом 48–72 часа, хотя точные сроки зависят от того, что покажут логи.

title: Email Marketing Account Setup & Professional Campaign Design for Accounting Business
description:
We are looking for an experienced Email Marketing Specialist to set up and configure a professional email marketing account for our accounting and bookkeeping outsourcing business.

Our target customers are accounting firms, CPA firms and small to medium-sized businesses across the USA.

We want to establish a professional email marketing system to promote our accounting and bookkeeping services and generate potential business enquiries.

Scope of Work

Email Marketing Account Setup

Recommend and set up a suitable email marketing platform (Brevo, Mailchimp, Instantly or similar).

Configure our business email address and domain.

Set up sender details and email authentication (SPF, DKIM and DMARC).

Ensure the account is properly configured for email deliverability.

Email Campaign Design

Create a professional and attractive email marketing template.

Use our company branding, logo, website and brand colours.

Design a mobile-friendly email template.

Include our accounting and bookkeeping services.

Add appropriate call-to-action buttons to generate enquiries.

Campaign Configuration

Set up email campaigns targeting US and Australian accounting firms.

Create separate campaign templates for both markets.

Configure personalisation fields and follow-up sequences where supported.

Set up campaign tracking and reporting.

Testing and Handover

Test emails on desktop and mobile devices.

Check links, formatting and email delivery.

Provide a complete handover with instructions on how to manage and send future campaigns.

Required Skills

Email Marketing

Brevo / Mailchimp / Instantly

Email Campaign Design

Email Automation

Email Deliverability

Domain Authentication (SPF, DKIM and DMARC)

B2B Marketing

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who has previous experience setting up email marketing systems for B2B businesses.

Please share:

Examples of email marketing campaigns you have designed.

Which email marketing platform you recommend and why.

Your experience with email deliverability and domain configuration.

Estimated completion time and project cost.

We are looking for a professional who can complete the initial setup and potentially support our future email marketing campaigns.

My focus is on:

• A straightforward dashboard that tracks completed jobs against the revenue generated 
• Secure in-app payments or payout tracking so users can follow their money without leaving the platform 

The design must feel clean and intuitive because the primary audience cares most about how quickly they can confirm a booking and check earnings. If you already have experience with cross-platform frameworks such as Flutter or React Native—and can connect to common payment gateways—that will help us move faster.

title: Telegram AI Support Chatbot
description:
I need an AI-driven Telegram bot that becomes the first point of contact for my customers. The bot must:

• Answer common product and service questions in natural language, pulling live information from my existing online system through its REST API. 
• Guide users through placing an order or booking a service, confirming details in real time. 
• Collect key customer details (name, phone, issue, preferred time, etc.) and seamlessly hand the conversation to a human agent when the request requires personal follow-up.

I will provide full API documentation along with test credentials so the bot can retrieve stock levels, pricing, and order status on demand. Please build with reliable NLP libraries (e.g., Python + aiogram, Node.js + Telegraf, or a comparable stack) and follow Telegram Bot API best practices—webhooks, HTTPS, and secure token management are mandatory.

Deliverables
1. Source code with clear setup instructions. 
2. Deployed bot running on my server (Docker or bare-metal OK). 
3. Brief user guide and a handover session so my team can update intents, responses, and API keys. 
4. Two-week post-launch support to fix any emergent issues.

Acceptance Criteria
• 90 %+ accuracy on FAQ responses during user testing. 
• Orders placed via the bot appear in our system with accurate line items. 
• Escalations trigger a human-handover alert in our support channel within five seconds.

If any part of the integration needs clarification, I’ll respond quickly so development can stay on schedule.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен Telegram-бот поддержки на базе ИИ: он отвечает на вопросы о товарах и услугах, получая актуальные данные через REST API клиента, помогает оформить заказ или запись с подтверждением деталей и передаёт диалог живому оператору с оповещением в канал поддержки.
analysis.reply:
You need a Telegram bot that answers product questions in natural language using live data from your REST API, walks customers through orders and bookings with real-time confirmation, and hands off to a human agent with an alert in your support channel within seconds. I'd build it in Python with aiogram, using webhooks over HTTPS, Docker on your server, and secrets kept in environment variables. The language layer would combine an LLM with intent routing so answers stay grounded in API data, and I'd check order line items against your system during testing. With modern tooling and AI-assisted development, I'd expect a first working version in about two weeks, then user testing against your 90% FAQ target. Could you share the API documentation and tell me which order fields the bot must read and write? Also, which support channel should receive the handover alerts?

See my work with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужен Telegram-бот, который отвечает на вопросы о товарах на естественном языке, используя актуальные данные из вашего REST API, проводит клиентов через оформление заказа и записи с подтверждением деталей в реальном времени и передаёт диалог живому оператору с оповещением в канале поддержки в течение нескольких секунд. title: Fix WATI Meta Permissions & PHP API
description:
I am looking for a developer experienced with WhatsApp Business API, Meta Business Manager, and Wati to resolve a setup/permissions issue and provide a working PHP snippet to send template messages.

What I have done so far:
1. Created a Wati account.
2. Connected my WhatsApp account to Wati.
3. Connected my Facebook/Meta account to Wati.
4. Created a message template in Wati.

The Issue:
When I try to submit the template, I get the following Meta Graph API error:
Unsupported post request. Object with ID '10***************28' does not exist, cannot be loaded due to missing permissions, or does not support this operation. Please read the Graph API documentation at https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api

Deliverables Needed:
1. Troubleshoot via screen share (AnyDesk/Zoom/Google Meet) to fix the Meta Business Manager / WABA permissions or Wati connection so templates submit and get approved properly.
2. Provide a clean, working PHP script (using cURL) that sends an approved template message via the Wati API.
3. Verify everything works with a successful live test message.

Requirements:
Please start your bid with the word "WATI" and briefly mention your experience fixing Meta WhatsApp Business API / WABA permission errors so I know you read the description.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент не может отправить шаблон сообщения через WATI из-за ошибки Meta Graph API (нет прав на объект WABA). Нужно исправить права в Meta Business Manager или подключение WATI и написать PHP-скрипт на cURL для отправки одобренного шаблона через WATI API с живым тестом. Бюджет 100 USD, задача через демонстрацию экрана.
analysis.reply:
WATI: The error means Meta can't access the WhatsApp Business Account object under the account submitting the template. That usually points to the Wati connection or the user's roles in Business Manager, not the template itself. I'd start with a short screen share to check the WABA roles and the Wati-to-Meta link, then confirm a template can be submitted. After that I'd write a cURL-based PHP script to send an approved template through the Wati API and run a live test message. I expect 1–2 days if admin access is available during the call. Are you the admin of the Business Manager, and is business verification already complete?
Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/
Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
WATI: Ошибка означает, что Meta не может получить доступ к объекту WhatsApp Business Account у аккаунта, который отправляет шаблон. Обычно это указывает на подключение WATI или роли пользователя в Business Manager, а не на сам шаблон. Я бы начал с короткой демонстрации экрана, чтобы проверить роли в WABA и связку Wati с Meta, а затем убедиться, что шаблон можно отправить на одобрение. title: Доработать узлы в автокад
description:
Описание 
1. Оформление графической части (схемы и чертежи): 
Цветовое выделение: На схемах оставить цветным только слой с КНС (кабеле несущие системы). Цветом выделять исключительно подаваемый объем 
Читаемость: Увеличить размер шрифта подписей к разрезам с элементами, а также указаний по монтажу к фермам. 
Формат: Основной чертеж скомпоновать на формате А3. 
Компоновка листов: Если разрезы и ведомость смонтированных конструкций не помещаются на основном листе, их разрешается перенести на дополнительный лист. Экспликация помещений не требуется. 
2. Состав и содержание ведомости конструкций: 
Ведомость должна содержать строго те позиции, которые попадают под выполнение (то есть те, что указаны в смете(ах) и РД+ в АН). 
Обязательное условие: Для каждого элемента (независимо от того, это шайба или лоток) на чертеже должна быть проставлена ссылка. 
3. Детализация узлов и расчетов: 
Количество: Указать количество узлов крепления под каждый разрез. 
Состав узла: Указать количество элементов в каждом узле. 
Логика расчета (пример): Если по согласованному АН решению применяется узел из труб (например, подпорка под лотки) и труба закрывается в тоннаже: 
На один узел расходуется, к примеру, 4 м трубы 25-й и 4 м трубы 40-й. 
Разрез и отметки должны быть отображены. 
Ниже должен быть приведен пересчет в тоннаж. 
Если таких узлов 5, и они применяются в разных местах — все должно быть отражено на чертеже, расписано и указано так, чтобы можно было посчитать объем.

Once the campaign is live and hitting the ground running, your job is done—I don’t need ongoing monthly management, just a solid launch that I can let Google’s automation optimise over time.

Deliverables I expect:
• Brief audit of the existing account (for context only) 
• New campaign build using Google AI features, location extensions and call-outs 
• Precise town/city targeting aligned to my service area 
• Conversion tracking (store visits, calls, driving-direction clicks) tested and active

If this sounds straightforward for you and you’re comfortable working directly in Google Ads, let’s get started so the new campaign can begin pulling in local customers right away.

title: Automatic Test Tube Capper/Decapper
description:
I am building a fully automatic machine that can both screw caps onto test tubes and remove them again in one seamless cycle. The system must reliably handle only screw-on caps—no snap-on lids or rubber stoppers—across a wide range of tube sizes: diameters from 0.5 in up to 5 in and lengths from 1 in to 10 in. 

During decapping, each cap has to drop straight into an integrated hopper inside the enclosure so they stay available for the next capping pass; the machine should never discard or individually pair caps with specific tubes.

What I need from you is a complete, production-ready solution that covers mechanical design, the capping/decapping torque mechanism, motion control, and operator-friendly software. Quick change-over or adjustable tooling for the stated size range is important, as are common laboratory considerations such as stainless-steel contact parts, easy cleaning, and splash protection.

Deliverables 
• Detailed 3-D CAD files, assembly drawings, and BOM 
• Control architecture and PCB program (or comparable controller) 
• Fabrication or prototype guidance proving the design meets the size and hopper-handling requirements 
• Commissioning support and a brief operating manual explaining settings for the different tube diameters and lengths 

If you have proven experience with product development, I look forward to seeing how you would approach this project and a rough timeline you can commit to.

description:
I’m looking to refine the single screen where users write their project description so that it guides them to produce a thorough, well-structured brief without feeling overwhelmed. What’s missing is the coaching—users often freeze or drop in one-line requests.

The goal is a cleaner, smarter layout that actively nudges them to include scope, required skills, deliverables and a timeline before they press Next. Micro-copy, dynamic placeholders, character or section progress indicators, or even inline examples are all welcome ideas if they remove friction and encourage richer briefs.

I don’t need the entire posting flow redesigned right now; only this description form. There’s no hard deadline, so take the time to explore solid UX approaches and iterate until we land on something intuitive.

• Wireframe variations for mobile and desktop breakpoints 
• High-fidelity prototype in Figma (or Sketch/Adobe XD if you prefer) ready for stakeholder review 
• Brief style guide covering typography, colours and micro-copy tone 
• Exportable assets and a hand-off link with organised layers and components 

I’ll test internally against completion rates and description length; success means more users submitting detailed briefs on the first try. Ready to craft a form that makes great project briefs the default?
